description: Skull Horde is an auto battler dungeon crawler where you play as a flying skull necromancer. Find powerful loot and create overpowered builds. Summon a horde of skeletons in a battle of bone versus flesh!

title: Gamblers table
description: Gamblers Table is an incremental game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely compelling...

title: Chop Chop Inc.
description: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp 🖕. Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

title: LOVE ETERNAL
description:
Run, jump, and reverse the flow of gravity itself to escape the mind of a selfish god in this challenging precision platformer. Play as Maya, a child stolen from her family on the whim of a lonely, forsaken deity, and make your way through over 100 screens filled with spikes, lasers, switches, and traps as you unravel the horrifying secret of your new prison.


Gorgeous hand-drawn pixel art graphics bring the god’s realm to life alongside meticulously handcrafted animations boasting many thousands of frames
A lush, atmospheric score, equal parts unsettling and beautiful
Responsive, snappy controls provide challenges with a sense of mastery and acrobatic accomplishment
A psychological horror narrative contorts and unfolds to reveal choices beyond comprehension

Will you find your way home, or wander these halls carved of memory forever?

title: Funi Raccoon Game
description: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

title: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
description: Make and share the most beautiful and bizarre medieval art imaginable! Manage and grow your manuscript workshop by illustrating manuscripts, using friendly tools and a massive range of drag-and-drop artworks from the deepest reaches of history. Welcome to your very own Scriptorium!

title: Tormentum II
description:
Tormentum II, a long-awaited continuation of the dark adventure game inspired by the works of H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksinski, will appear on the Steam platform in 2019.
In 2019, thanks to the Polish studio OhNoo, the door to the dark world of Tormentum will open again. Tormentum II is a Point & Click adventure game taking place in a dark, surreal world full of gloomy characters and repulsive creatures taken straight from the scariest horrors. The hand-drawn graphics, referring to the work of outstanding painters such as H.R.Giger or Zdzisław Beksiński, will take care of the one-of-a-kind impressions that spice up the players with shivers.
This time the adventure will begin in the future - in a universe where computer games bring relief in a hopeless world devastated by technology. Players will lead the fate of a game creator whose ambition is to create what has never been achieved before - a world inhabited by characters with intelligence equal to that of a human being.
When one day he receives a mysterious package with a strange processor, worrying visions begin to haunt him. Reality mixes with a nightmare, and characters from the game begin to penetrate his world. Or maybe it’s the other way round...
He decides to place a mysterious processor in his computer. From that moment nothing is certain anymore, and he himself becomes a prisoner of his own creation.
He wakes up in prison on an island in the middle of the sea and starts exploring the world he has created. However, he turns out to be different from his imagination - much less friendly, much more aggressive. However, one thing puzzles him the most: the characters he encounters tell him about a god who lives on one of the most remote islands. About a god who has never been in his game, which he himself has not created.
Players will be able to get to know the huge dark world stretching to several islands.  Full of secrets and rich in various creatures. In order to find his way home and find a mysterious god along the way, the protagonist will have to travel through a vast land, which will consist of more than 130 locations - twice as many as in the first part of the adventure.
While wandering around the world, players will encounter situations in which game developers will question their conscience, forcing them to make often ambiguous decisions affecting the fate of the characters they meet. Thanks to such a procedure, the linearity of the game will be disturbed, which will enable more than one ending, depending on the choices made by the protagonist.
The unique atmosphere accompanying the game will be emphasized by a unique musical setting, this time enriched with metal sounds.

title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
description: Odesa, 2044. A cyberpunk metropolis in the crossfire of corporate wars. You aren't a hero - you're an engineer fighting to survive. Lead your squad in this turn-based tactical RPG with destructible environments. Install military implants and hack enemy networks. Every mission reshapes the city.

title: Subway Surfers City
description:
Run, jump, dodge and explore Subway Surfers City! Jake and his crew are waiting. Run wild and prove that you can rise
to the challenge!
Billions of players can't be wrong - run and jump back into the beloved world of Subway Surfers and rediscover your
favorite endless running adventure with exciting new twists. Progress through fresh hurdles, reach new heights, and
collect new characters!
Jake, Tricky, Fresh, and Yutani are ready - are you? Play Subway Surfers City now!

title: Clockwork Ambrosia
description: Clockwork Ambrosia is a steampunk fusion of metroidvania and weapon-building 2D shooter. Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapon modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

title: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
description:
IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator DEMO is available here .




A brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery simulator where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Every lever, every dial, and every shot is under your control. High Command may send its orders, but the chain of command ends at your fingertips. They don't carry consequences. You do.

MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT.



Calibrate the teleprinters to monitor local radio traffic, push the dial far enough, and unfamiliar channels will answer. One delivers High Command's directives. The other relays direct calls from the frontline. Remember: Sometimes the most useful message is the one nobody intended to send.



Transform reports into a battle plan, get aerial photos that reveal the outcome of your actions, and watch your barrels reshape the landscape. The map isn't here just for measurements. It's also your window to the battlefield. Make no mistake. You can move the markers, but the scars remain.



Hammer the measurements, crank the numbers, and watch the ballistic calculator grind toward firing solutions. Drive the charges higher to blast shells across the horizon, or dial it back to arc them deliberately into enemy emplacements. Beware: the machine may fail. You must not.



Breach bunkers with AP rounds, screen friendly withdrawals with smoke, and ████ █████████ with phosgene gas. It never happened if there are no witnesses. Every shell is forged for a single purpose, and whatever you choose will echo across the battlefield long after the smoke clears.


Haul the elevation wheel and watch the guns climb under your command. Match it with the exact propellant charge, or a surgical strike will turn into an avoidable mess. Precision is everything because neither flawless paperwork nor the finest propaganda will erase your guilt.


Drag the heavy lever and feel the entire structure shudder beneath your feet. A machine like IRON NEST doesn't spin on a whim. It takes time to swing that much iron with grace. Skilled Operators use that time to handle other tasks. After all, the coffee machine on your desk is there for a reason.



Pull the trigger, and let thousands of tons of machinery answer your call. Feel the turret recoil and watch the frontline crumble under the weight of steel. Once the dust settles, only silence remains, hanging heavy in the air, and the moment new orders arrive, it all begins again.


Key Features
✔ Heavy-Artillery Simulator
✔ Dieselpunk Aesthetics
✔ Interactive Tactical Map
✔ Hands-On Massive Mechanisms
✔ Manual Control of a 5,000 Ton Turret
✔ Procedurally Generated Objectives
✔ Endless Replayability
✔ 8x Challenge Modes
✔ Leaderboards
✔ Handcrafted Story
✔ Newspaper Reports
✔ Unlockable 30x Ammo Types
✔ Unlockable 20x Abilities
✔ 15x Regions


Setting
The campaign is set in alternate-history Spain in the late 1920s, on the brink of a civil war. In this timeline, the monarchy still holds power, and a republican uprising is spreading across the country.

The Team
IRON NEST is a two-person passion project from Nick Talmers (development) and Dominik Latos (propaganda). With 20 years of combined experience and a lifelong obsession with artillery, interwar machinery, and dieselpunk, we're building the game we've wanted to play for years.

Nick has dreamed of IRON NEST for over a decade, and after meeting through developer-publisher collaborations, we decided it was time to bring this heavy spider-turret simulator, dripping with steel and power, to life.

Acknowledgements
The response has exceeded our wildest expectations. Thank you (truly) for every wishlist, message, and bit of support. It means even more because Heavy Turret Simulator is just the first step in the IRON NEST universe.


IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator is a first-person heavy-artillery experience that blends tactical problem-solving, complex war-machine management, and strategic decision-making into a genre of its own. The inspirations behind the game range from 1990s anime and Cannon Fodder to Nick’s passion for engineering and artillery. Also, we would like to acknowledge PVKK, which, in our view, helped shape the genre in which IRON NEST proudly stands.

HEARING LOSS IS NOT SERVICE-RELATED

Find out more about IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator here!

title: Berry Bury Berry
description: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

title: Ultima Underworld II
description:
To commemorate the defeat of the Guardian’s forces one year ago, you (the Avatar) and the leaders of Britannia are invited to Lord British’s castle for an evening of celebration. Suddenly, the Guardian strikes again, encasing the building in a gigantic blackrock gem. He offers the imprisoned heroes a simple choice: proclaim him ruler of all Britannia, or starve while his minions conquer the land.
Searching underground for an escape route, you discover a smaller version of the gem that surrounds the castle, and find that its facets are portals to other worlds. These worlds are also under the Guardian’s domination, but with your help, the inhabitants may be able to throw off the evil titan’s yoke.
Time is running out, food and water are running low, and an agent of the Guardian is killing off the imprisoned heroes one by one. You hold Britannia’s fate in your hands once again.
Features
Eight new worlds to explore - from fantastic castles to ice caverns, towers and alien realms.
An expanded, more panoramic 3-D view window - 30% larger than before!
Larger, higher-resolution creature graphics with additional frames of animation for smoother, more lifelike movement.
New trap and puzzle types featuring animated, multi-level obstacles, moving terrain, pressure-sensitive triggers and more!
Detailed, close-up portraits of scores of characters whose attitudes and actions vary based on your decisions.
New magical spells of unimaginable power - attack around corners with Deadly Seeker; bowl your enemies over with Shockwave; create deadly artifacts with Poison Weapon!
Treacherous new terrain features with slippery ice and dangerous currents designed to challenge even the most experienced dungeon-delver.
Full, dynamic musical score with digitized speech and sound effects.

title: Flock Around
description: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!

title: Below, Rusted Gods
description: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

title: Knytt Classic
description:
The indie freeware classic returns! It's been 20 years since visionary Swedish indie developer Nifflas (Rhythm Doggo, Ynglet) released Knytt, the first title in the atmospheric platforming series. Made with the help of a passionate group of internet forum collaborators, the game was released for free on the web in 2006, and later followed up by Knytt Stories (2007) and Knytt Underground (2012). IGN called Knytt "an extremely soothing and memorable ambient adventure", while Edge Magazine remarked it was "pure platforming pleasure and a wonderfully soothing soundscape."

To help celebrate the 20th anniversary, Bit Kid (Chasm, WOLFHOUND) is proud to present Knytt Classic, a free pixel-perfect port with full controller support, achievements, bonus modes, display effects, and much more!

Story
Guide the Knytt, a peaceful being who is abducted by aliens for a cruise across the solar system and ends up crash-landing on another world. Explore the atmospheric, maze-like planet and collect all the parts from your crashed ship in order to return home. As Edge put it, "There’s no combat, no switches, and no real puzzles to speak of, just plentiful checkpoints, pure platforming pleasure and a wonderfully soothing soundscape."

"A sprawling 2D wonderland of subtly animated backdrops and curiously charismatic creatures"
-Edge Magazine

"The video game equivalent of curling up and unwinding with a nice, relaxing book"
-IGN

"Relaxed, low-key adventure that’s a great change of pace from the usual adrenaline rush"
-Hardcore Gamer Magazine

Features
A pixel-perfect port of Nifflas' indie freeware classic Knytt (2006)
Over 1,500 screens to explore across the original game and three bonus modes
Bonus Modes include UltraTough, a brand new challenging mode by Bit Kid, Hempuli’s (Baba Is You, Environment Station Alpha) mod Knytt XH (Extra Hard), and Brutally Unfair Knytt’s remixed world
Achievements & hidden bonuses
Full gamepad support and remappable controls
Multiple aspect ratios & display effects, including retro CRT and handheld LCD styles
Optional in-game timer and fastest completion time tracking
Windows, Mac, & Linux support

title: Corsairs - Battle of the Caribbean
description:
Luttez pour la suprématie de votre nation dans les Caraïbes du côté Français, Danois, Espagnol, Britannique ou Néerlandais.
Sorti il y a plus de 20 ans, Corsairs vous permettait d’incarner un corsaire au service de l'Angleterre, de la France ou encore des Pays Bas, en quête de renommée et de richesse pour son pays. Dans Corsairs - La Bataille des Caraïbes, le jeu de stratégie se réinvente dans le monde toujours très prisé des flibustiers, en y apportant une touche de modernité bienvenue.

Combat naval tactique
- Commandez une flotte de 12 types de navires distincts et engagez-vous dans des batailles navales tactiques où le positionnement, les statistiques des navires et le choix des munitions sont décisifs.
- Utilisez 3 types de munitions, chacun avec des effets uniques, pour adapter votre approche selon la situation.
- Choisissez entre 3 types de soldats : Tanks, Gunners et Agiles pour former la force principale de votre équipage.
Progression de la flotte et améliorations
- Améliorez vos navires, flottes, ports et bâtiments pour améliorer les statistiques clés et débloquer de nouvelles possibilités stratégiques.
- Des décisions d'investissement prudentes sont essentielles pour maintenir une domination à long terme sur les routes commerciales et les forces ennemies.
Abordage & Capture de Navire
- Engagez-vous dans des abordages pour combattre les équipages ennemis au corps à corps.
- L'abordage vous permet de capturer les navires ennemis au lieu de les détruire, obligeant les joueurs à choisir entre une élimination rapide ou des engagements plus risqués pour agrandir leur flotte.
Factions Dynamiques & Choix Tactiques
- En plus des grandes nations, des factions de pirates opèrent en tant que tiers indépendants, créant des rencontres imprévisibles et des décisions tactiques supplémentaires pendant les parties.
Mode Campagne – Cinq Nations
- Jouez à travers cinq campagnes, représentant la France, l’Angleterre, le Danemark, l’Espagne et les Pays-Bas, chacune offrant ses propres défis stratégiques et objectifs à travers les Caraïbes.
Mode Escarmouche
- Plongez dans le mode Escarmouche contre des adversaires IA ou d'autres joueurs en ligne.
- Les parties privées et publiques sont prises en charge, avec un système de classement basé sur l'Elo garantissant un matchmaking compétitif.

title: Mario Tennis Fever
description:
Mario Tennis Fever is a multiplayer sports game in the Mario Tennis series released worldwide for the Nintendo Switch 2 on February 12, 2026 as part of the Super Mario Bros. 40th Anniversary celebration. First announced during the September 2025 Nintendo Direct, it is the ninth installment in the Mario Tennis series, and the first Mario sports game to be released on the Nintendo Switch 2. The gameplay elements are similar to those of Mario Tennis Aces, but the game introduces new features, including Fever Rackets. Each Fever Racket has its own special abilities, creating unique effects on the court. Players can build up their Fever Gauge during rallies, allowing them to use new tactics with Fever Shots. The game incorporates elements from Super Mario Bros. Wonder in modes such as the Tournament and Mix It Up.

title: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar
description: Portal with cats - Become entangled in a quantum puzzle adventure! Mittens gains the incredible power to be in two places at once. Explore twisted test chambers, make mischief and evade capture by a whisker! 🐈🐈‍⬛

title: SiN Reloaded
description:
From Nightdive Studios, SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits.


Enter a near-future dystopian world as security consultant Colonel John R. Blade as you take on the seductively evil Doctor Elexis Sinclaire. When Elexis, the CEO of SinTEK Industries, begins injecting the streets with a DNA-altering drug, it's time to reassess the laws of morality. As Blade, you've made a religion out of fighting crime. Now you're going to make Elexis pay for her sins by taking on her unholy army of genetically-engineered mutants.


SiN was celebrated for introducing a groundbreaking amount of interactivity in every level. Hack your way into computer terminals using DOS-style code, use  elevators and security cameras to wreak havoc, you can even zip around in a forklift, patrol boat and a helicopter. Your actions have consequences, creating  branching paths as the game progresses. SiN also helped to pioneer the ability to knock weapons out of an opponent's hands and take area-specific damage from their attacks.


SiN: Reloaded includes the Wages of SiN extra mission pack, where you take on a diabolical mafia boss with a new army of dangerous mutants. Both games have been optimized using the KEX Engine to play on modern systems. The graphics throughout have been beautifully remastered with new textures, control schemes have been modernized, and maps have been improved with Nightdive’s established precision.

Features
Play the original SiN and the SiN: Wages of Sin extra mission pack, optimized using the KEX Engine.
Beautifully remastered graphics with HD textures and models, (up to) 4K resolution at 144 FPS, anti-aliasing, and upgraded 2D screens and menu art.
Overhauled control schemes and modernized UI.
Improved maps throughout the game.
Swap between remastered visuals and the original SiN Gold version.
Brand-new achievements.
Higher resolution Zak Belika tracks mixed/engineered by Chris Mock.

title: The Walking Trade
description: Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
description: Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!

title: Blossom: The Seed of Life
description:
Dissipez le brouillard en augmentant la pression et formez de la glace. Faites-la fondre en augmentant la température. Transformez la poussière martienne en terre, puis verdissez la planète avec des algues. Plantez des fleurs et des arbres pour generer de l'oxygène et rendre le ciel bleu. Cultivez des forêts, créez des biomes, puis donnez vie à la planète en incubant des insectes, des oiseaux et des animaux.


Explorez une planète inconnue. Parcourez Mars à pied, en rover ou dans les airs pour atteindre des régions lointaines afin de trouver des ressources ou simplement admirer les résultats de vos efforts. Découvrez des stations abandonnées, des machines anciennes et des épaves de vaisseaux. Visitez des plateformes orbitales et reconstituez ce qui est arrivé à la Terre et à ceux qui vous ont précédé.

Vous incarnez Blossom, un petit robot capable, conçu pour survivre là où les humains ne le peuvent pas. La gestion de l'énergie est au cœur du gameplay : alimentez vos déplacements, vos outils et vos machines pour rester opérationnel dans un environnement hostile. Incarner un robot change votre interaction avec le monde. L'électricité remplace la nourriture, une gestion prudente de l'énergie est donc la clé de votre progression.


Récoltez les ressources de Mars, raffinez les matériaux, automatisez grâce aux drones, et construisez des outils, des machines et des structures. Débloquez des plans, ameliorez votre technologie et construisez des bases qui évoluent avec la planète, soutenant la terraformation, l'exploration et la survie de manières de plus en plus complexes.


Construisez et personnalisez des rovers modulaires, fixez des modules fonctionnels comme des batteries, du stockage et des lasers de minage, et liez-les pour former des convois. Parcourez la planète, minez en route et créez des avant-postes mobiles ou fixes partout où l'exploration vous mène. Votre base n'est pas liée à un seul endroit. Elle se déplace avec vous, permettant une exploration à l'échelle planétaire.

title: Woodo
description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.


Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.


With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.


Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
Simple but deeply meaningful story
The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile

title: Endacopia
description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

title: D1AL-ogue
description: Become an android repair technician in a cyberpunk city where the sun never rises. Rotate the unique circular puzzle 'D1AL' and merge modules to fix their broken bodies and hearts. Your precise repair is the conversation starter. Turn the dial and listen to their stories.

title: Transport Fever 3
description:
Pre-order Transport Fever 3 now to get the exclusive content that adds iconic scale and atmosphere to your world:
A Brand-New Historical Vehicle:
- TS Queen Mary: legendary ocean liner, meticulously recreated in stunning detail
A World-Famous Landmark:
- Great Pyramid: most iconic wonder of the ancient world
A Majestic Wildlife Addition:
- Asian elephant: majestic symbol of strength and life in tropical regions

Plan, build, and optimize! Transport Fever 3 puts you in charge of your own transport empire. From humble beginnings with horse-drawn wagons, steam trains, and paddle-steamers working towards the latest jet planes, supertankers, high-speed trains, and helicopters, you will build the network that drives the world!

Every delivery earns money, while every train, truck, plane, or ship increases your costs. You’ll plan and build profitable routes, balance infrastructure expenses, and invest in upgrades to stay ahead of growing demand.

With success comes the financial freedom to expand your reach, while earning the right to build world famous landmarks to demonstrate your achievements. Fall short, and you’ll be seeking efficiencies and improvements to propel your company forward.

As your influence expands, the needs of every city become more challenging to fulfill. There's no such thing as one plan that works forever, you will need to adapt, overcome, and solve problems as they come up, balancing your desire for growth with the needs of the populations you serve.



BECOME THE TYCOON
Build your personal transport empire by creating perfect routes to maximise your profits. Ensure that cargo and people get where they need to be, when they need to be. Manage and optimize your vehicle fleet, balance maintenance costs, efficiency, and priorities. Resolve bottlenecks and meet the evolving demands of dynamic towns and a multitude of industries that operate on- and offshore. Develop commercial centers, industrial powerhouses, and commuter cities by specializing deliveries and mastering every transport decision.



CONNECT THE WORLD
Connect towns and industries to fuel their growth. Plan and construct rails, roads, sea- and airways to build your transport empire. Grow tiny villages into major cities as you master traffic priorities and management systems. Analyze trouble using data layers and visual displays to identify traffic hotspots, delivery problems, or excessive noise and pollution. Make use of intuitive building tools to further optimize your network and grow from small country roads to highways and from old-wooden rails to modern high-speed tracks.



EXPERIENCE A LIVING SIMULATION
Every citizen has a home, a job, and places to go in the expanded living simulation, letting you follow each one along the way. Dynamic weather and a full day-night cycle let you experience your world in countless moods, from sunny mornings to rainy, clouded afternoons. Each of the four climate zones brings unique challenges, from temperate valleys and subarctic swamps, to desert plains and tropical islands, all demanding a fresh approach to your transportation strategy.​



PLAY IT YOUR WAY
Customize your game with multiple difficulty options, enabling you to create your perfect game. Adjust the way the world, economy, and its citizens react to your style of play. Design ultimate tycoon adversity, that will test you to the limit, as you race to complete contract objectives in the fastest possible time. Ease the difficulty to a more relaxed setting and play for fun, or disable the economy entirely and build the most stunning city, station, or diorama you can imagine.



WRITE TRANSPORT HISTORY
Solve epic transport missions from history that will test your planning, efficiency, and cunning in the extensive story campaign. Immerse in the full tycoon experience, making use of the largest range of vehicles in the series that spans over a century of transport evolution. The whole world, including buildings, people, and cars, follow designs and trends through time. Rewrite transportation history and run steam trains and jets side by side as you progress through the 20th century and beyond.



CREATE WITHOUT LIMITS
Modding tools have been greatly improved, enabling mod creators to bring their favourite vehicles, buildings, and infrastructure to life. The fully featured in-game map editor allows anyone to craft maps closely matching reality or drawn from your wildest imagination. Share your creations or expand your collection and the scope of your worlds with ease using the in-game mod browser, expanding the range of possibilities in directions that will keep your experience fresh again and again.



BUILT ON WHAT WORKS
Transport Fever 3 builds on everything that has made the series a favorite among transport and tycoon fans for years. Every system has been refined, every feature expanded, and every tool streamlined to deliver the most complete and rewarding experience yet. With smarter cities, deeper logistics, improved performance, and an even greater focus on tycoon gameplay, it’s the ultimate evolution of a proven formula, built for both newcomers and veterans to enjoy for years to come.


FEATURE OVERVIEW
Tycoon mode with highly-adjustable difficulty to set the perfect level of challenge
Sandbox mode to build with unrestricted creativity and strong mod support
Campaign mode featuring entertaining missions inspired by real historic events
Map editor to design comprehensive maps in-game and accessible modification tools
Wide range of tricky achievements with unique goals and rewarding challenges
More than 125 years of transport evolution - from horse-drawn wagons to high-speed trains
275 realistic vehicles such as trains, buses, trams, trucks, ships, aircraft and helicopters
All major transport types covered, including light rail systems and dedicated cargo trams
Modular infrastructure spanning multiple eras - from classic train stations to modern airports
Physically-based atmosphere and cloud-coverage, day/night cycle and dynamic lighting
Multiple highly immersive climate zones, including a brand new subarctic region
Randomly generated maps with distinct biomes that offer unique game-play challenges
Town growth featuring dynamic districts based on simulating individual inhabitants
Advanced traffic simulation with lane control and realistic behavior such as overtaking
Landmarks inspired by real-world architecture, adding character to towns and regions
Over 35 unique industries, including off-shore sectors such as fishing grounds and oil platforms
Demand-driven industry expansion with production boosted by workers and optional inputs
Redesigned cargo simulation providing full control over loading and unloading
Warehouses and specialized terminals for intermediate storage and logistics optimization
Dynamic loan and contract system offering risk versus reward opportunities
Simple yet deep game mechanics based on maintenance, noise/pollution, reputation and more
Extensive customization options ensuring a high replay value and diverse play styles
Powerful road and track construction tools including overland trams and highway ramps
Flexible road design options with individual tram lanes and configurable lane connections
Intuitive landscaping tools for terrain sculpting, ground painting and vegetation placement
Cross-platform modding support with in-game mod browser for easy content discovery

title: Nova Roma
description:
Alors que l’Empire romain, autrefois grandiose, sombre dans la décadence et la déchéance, vous menez un petit groupe de citoyens à la recherche d’un nouveau territoire pour y fonder Nova Roma, l’incarnation de tout ce que l’Empire avait de bon. Commencez par un humble village, apaisez les dieux avec des temples somptueux, répondez aux nombreux besoins de vos citoyens et bâtissez une société que le monde entier jalousera pendant des millénaires.


En tant qu’urbaniste, vous allez exploiter le monde qui vous entoure. Érigez des barrages et des aqueducs gigantesques pour contrôler l’écoulement de l’eau tout en remodelant la terre en bassins et réservoirs artificiels et en portant une attention particulière à l’impact de vos actions sur la fertilité du sol. Mettez-vous en quête de gisements de ressources lointains et construisez des infrastructures pour transporter les matières premières et les produits transformés à travers les vastes étendues sauvages. Parviendrez-vous à maintenir l’équilibre fragile entre l’étalement urbain de votre ville et les risques d’une expansion trop rapide ? Ou votre orgueil attisera-t-il la colère des dieux et de la nature ?


Affrontez une liste croissante de besoins et de désirs à mesure que les nouveaux habitants affluent dans votre ville. Assurez le bonheur et la sécurité de la population en lui fournissant des poteries, du vin, du pain et des jeux. Regardez vos citoyens devenir des artisans, des gladiateurs ou des acteurs, et guidez-les tout au long de leur vie, pendant leurs journées de dur labeur et leurs soirées de divertissement.


Ajustez les impôts de votre cité et débloquez de nouvelles technologies, mais n’oubliez pas les puissances qui vous observent : bâtissez des temples sublimes pour les dieux, évitez leur colère et cherchez leur bénédiction afin de renforcer vos capacités et d’assurer la prospérité de Nova Roma.


Intégrant une simulation poussée de l’eau et la menace omniprésente d’une intervention divine, Nova Roma vous fait traverser les épreuves culturelles, politiques et sociales de l’époque. Occupez-vous de votre petite ville romaine et faites-en une métropole animée qui résistera à l’épreuve du temps !

title: Coffee Talk Tokyo
description:
Dans une ville de papier et d’acier aussi vaste qu’un pays tout entier, un petit café offre un espace de réconfort aux humains comme aux yōkai. Préparez la bonne commande pour vos clients, qui viennent chez vous trouver un peu de fraîcheur et de compassion dans la touffeur de l’été, sur une bande-son chill lo-fi.

À Tokyo, où coexistent l’ancien et le moderne, ce nouveau titre de la franchise Coffee Talk allie éléments connus et surprises.

Nouveau café, nouveaux clients

Coffee Talk Tokyo vous place à nouveau derrière le comptoir d’un paisible coffee-shop. L’ambiance vous semble familière, mais les clients et leurs histoires restent à découvrir :
Kenji, le salarié kappa classique, en quête de sens et de direction après la retraite.
Vin, qui assiste la barista et tente de gérer un passé compliqué, ainsi que les conséquences quotidiennes d’un désastre.
Ayame, fantôme insouciant qui peine à trouver un sens à sa vie (après la mort).
Bande-son lo-fi composée par Andrew AJ Jeremy

Après avoir composé la bande-son de Coffee Talk et Coffee Talk Episode 2, AJ revient avec de nouveaux sons, dans une atmosphère lo-fi et paisible.
Dessinez-les

Faites progresser l’art du latte. Créez de magnifiques compositions en saupoudrant les boissons des clients, avant d’ajouter du lait et de l’eau-forte.

Tomodachill

Discutez avec vos clients sur le réseau social Tomodachill. Apprenez-en davantage sur leur vie, aidez-les à découvrir leur vérité ou à prendre d’importantes décisions.

title: Origament: A Paper Adventure
description: Become a living letter and find your way to the one who still waits for you! Fly, sail, roll, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and continents in this adventure platformer!😸

title: Code Vein 2
description: An epic adventure awaits, where you and your chosen partners explore a post-apocalyptic world, face fierce battles against powerful enemies, and uncover an epic story that transcends time.

title: Heroes of Science and Fiction
description: A turn-based sci-fi strategy that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies for your heroes and destroy your opponents! This HoMM-like is set in a scifi universe, with new mechanics on top of the classic formula.

title: Insomnia: Chapter One
description: 2012. The Arctic research station "Persei" loses contact with the outside world. You are Ethan Miller, a technician sent to the facility to fix the issues. But something here has clearly gone out of control.

title: Little One
description:
Experience a unique adventure in this Anime visual novel set in the 1900s. Take care of an orphan boy with a secret past and nurture him through different plot choices and skill options.
"Can you take him in for a while?" - One fateful night a friend who I have not seen for many years drops by with an orphan boy and asks me to take him in. Suddenly I have to take care of a child! And not just any child - there seem to be some hidden secrets bubbling just beneath the surface of that innocent face. It's time to look for answers.
- Choose from a variety of skills to build Jake's character
- Hone your skills carefully - you never know when they'll come in hand throughout the story!
- Build your relationship by choosing the right dialogue options...and see how everything unfurls if you choose wrongly.
- Create a daily schedule to use your time wisely before it runs out!
- Look forward to various exciting story endings
A timid, polite and scared orphan boy with a mysterious past who needs someone to take care of him.
My childhood friend who suddenly turns up in the middle of the night with this orphan boy and then heads off into the city again, where he works as a doctor.
A friendly book shop owner who has lost her voice but is always willing to help.

title: Wasteland Bites
description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

title: Goth Obsession: Touch Adventure
description: Romantic clicker with original voice acting and plenty of Goth Girls characters. Unlock game items for the accumulated points and pump up your Touch!...

title: EA SPORTS College Football 27
description: Step into the modern era of college football, where personal ambition meets program pride. Balance expectations, identity, and everything Saturday demands while immersed in traditions and pageantry of game day.

title: Fear The Timeloop
description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.

title: Dimhaven - The Lost Source
description: Are you ready for an adventure? Challenges, exploration and puzzles in a narrative driven experience, pick up your camera and test your wits in this first-person mystery by the team behind Quern!

title: A Game About Chopping Trees
description: Grab your axe, hop on the handcar, and lose yourself in the forest. Chop trees, upgrade your gear, and enjoy the ride - alone or with a friend

title: Koloboke Sickness Simulator
description: Only Up + First-person rolling mechanics. This combo is pure madness. Try not to fall!

title: Homura Hime
description: Homura Hime is an anime-style 3D action game merging exhilarating thrills with the tension-filled gameplay of bullet hell. Players dodge hails of projectiles, unleash combos that blend close-quarters and ranged attacks, and utilize dodges and parries to withstand the fierce onslaught of demons.

title: Ova Magica
description:
Work in progressRemember that the game is still in development and the footage shown is not final. Do you have questions, ideas and would you like to be part of the development process? Do not hesitate to contact the developer!Main features
You can grow crops and fruit trees and take care of your blob animals! Work hard to create your own dream farm! You need good products to produce quality feed for your blobs.
Blobs hatch from eggs and it's up to you to train them!
Unlike other games, you don't receive experience points after battle. To make your blobs stronger, you must feed them well, pet them and use specific skills in battles.
Your blobs can also help you with your farm work.
You can make friends and build relationships with different characters. Talking, battling and gifting increases your friendship and unlocks new events, places and more. There are wonderful stories you can experience!
Fight against other trainers and wild blobs. Experience a strategic Active Time Battle system with a little twist! Attacks throw you back to the ATB bar and can even cancel your current action. Think carefully when it's time to defend and when to attack. Also plan to use the right skill type to gain elementary advantages.
You can explore dangerous mazes where you can find eggs and rare treasures. These dungeons change every time you enter them! In the end a strong blob boss guards the rare eggs. A tough battle awaits you!
Grow stronger and unique blobs! You can crossbreed all blobs!
Create your dream team and become the strongest trainer.
Enjoy many wholesome activities like fishing, bug catching, cooking and more!
Gather resources to  create new items with the workbench and decorate your farm and home!

title: Heavy Hearts
description:
An extinction event took place.
Luccia is one of the few survivors of an invasion by an ancient race called the "Glithe".
She nearly died, but managed to escape by mere chance.

Only a few humans remain living in isolation and those that are found are used for labor, pleasure, or worse...

You play as Luccia, a warrior torn from her home, with only her friend Rhed they must stop the extinction, even if that means Luccia must repopulate the human race...

As an action RPG, Heavy Hearts will challenge you against various foes, bosses, and super bosses. Each one is uniquely crafted and suited to force Luccia to use various skills in her arsenal.
Strike your opponent's with Luccia's trusty blade, the Claymost.
Charge your Aether and disintegrate foe's with magic
Infuse Elements into your attacks to exploit enemy weaknesses
Use precision heavy strikes at the right moment to finish monsters off
Beware of lewd traps that could slow Luccia down!


With 16 explorable realms over two continents, there will be much to traverse as the quest continues
Collect rare items in combat, or throughout the realm. Use them to advance other quests or to trade for upgrades.
Find exciting denizens along the way that have unclear motives, but just might help you under the right conditions.
Trust nobody - Humans are rare finds these days. Don't give anyone a chance to turn you in.
Sneak around the villages or use a disguise - This way, Luccia is safe from being discovered.


Meet fantastical, diverse mythological races across the land of Arteria
Make lasting relationships with your team mates, and maybe some enemies too.
Conversate with your teammates, and build friendships into something more...

title: The Occultist
description:
HISTOIRE ET UNIVERS
Dans The Occultist, l’enquêteur Alan Rebels, spécialiste du paranormal, se rend sur l’île maudite de Sacrepierre pour élucider le mystère de la subite disparition de son père. Bien que ce dernier ait mentionné l’île de nombreuses fois durant sa vie, tout ce que sait Alan, c’est que son père y est né et y a passé son enfance.
Alan, cependant, n’est pas seul dans son voyage. Il a pris son pendule occulte, un objet d’origine inconnue et fidèle compagnon lors de ses précédentes enquêtes. Alors qu’il explore les ruelles embrumées et les bâtiments inquiétants de l’île apparemment désertée de Sacrepierre, une seule chose paraît évidente : cette affaire ne sera pas comme les autres.
L’île de Sacrepierre était habitée jusqu’en 1950 par une secte macabre, tristement connue pour les expériences indicibles et les rituels cruels qu’elle aimait à réaliserDepuis, plus personne n’a osé se rendre sur l’île... jusqu’à ce jour. À l’aide de ses dons paranormaux, Alan doit interagir avec les âmes menaçantes emprisonnées dans les restes des rues sombres et des bâtiments encore présents sur Sacrepierre... Mais peut-être devrait-il plutôt les éviter pour ne pas risquer leur ire.
Alan Rebels est un enquêteur spécialisé dans le paranormal, et rien de tout cela ne l’étonne. Cependant, l’île mystérieuse de Sacrepierre et le mystère de la disparition de son père vont mettre les compétences d’Alan à rude épreuve. Cette enquête pas comme les autres va montrer à Alan ce dont sont réellement capables les forces de l’occulte. Peut-être est-il possible de lever la malédiction qui semble peser sur Sacrepierre... mais le faut-il vraiment ?

FONCTIONNALITÉS
Pendule occulte : L’objet le plus important que possède Alan. Il lui permet d’interagir avec son environnement et de le modifier grâce à ses quatre mécanismes uniques et originaux.
Action à la première personne : Découvrez le monde inquiétant de The Occultist à travers les yeux d’Alan Rebels et utilisez son pendule occulte pour faire la lumière sur les secrets de Sacrepierre.
Survie et horreur : The Occultist possède tous les éléments du genre ; exploration, atmosphère angoissante et une narration centrée sur le personnage.
Graphismes de nouvelle génération : The Occultist vous offre une extraordinaire qualité graphique afin de vous plonger dans une expérience horrifique parfaitement immersive.
Cache-cache : Alan évite toujours la confrontation directe. À l’aide des mécanismes d’infiltration, il doit parvenir à progresser dans l’aventure sans être pris de court.
Des personnages mémorables : Sacrepierre est peuplée d’adversaires qui vous mèneront la vie dure.
Énigmes : Toutes sortes d’énigmes, des plus simples à celles qui feront appel à vos plus profondes connaissances des arts occultes.
Bande-son : The Occultist vous propose une bande-son originale, œuvre du célèbre compositeur Pepe Herrero.

title: Warhammer Survivors
description:
The addictive bullet-heaven action of the survivors genre comes to the 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms in an officially licensed game from Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors).
Experience Warhammer’s epic champions, enemies, weapons and more, meticulously handcrafted in animated pixel glory.

- Frenetic Bullet Heaven survival in a grim dark setting
- Over 40 iconic playable characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, featuring Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s very own Malum Caedo!
- Multiple modes and stages from across the grim, dark 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms.
- An arsenal of 75+ weapons, such as the Boltgun, Astartes Chainsword, Whirlwind Axes and easter eggs such as the humble pot of Nuln Oil.
- Face down the mightiest monsters the universes have to offer, including the disgustingly bloated Great Unclean One. Extremis Bosses pose a challenge even for Survivors-like veterans!
- A mighty cache of passives and power-ups to aid in enduring against the monstrous legions.
- Esoteric secrets to uncover and collectables to collect!
- ...and more!

Choose your universe and become a legend of the Imperium or champion of Order in frenetic battles across the open and ashen plains of Aqshy to the tight and confined corridors of an abandoned Space Hulk. Every stage is a new arena of slaughter, each with its own enemy faction... and secrets to uncover.

Unlock and choose from over 40 of your favorite characters from both the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes. Play as the legendary Commissar, Sebastian Yarrick, and the lightning-forged Stormcast Eternal, Neave Blacktalon, among a host of others. Each character comes with unique weapons and starting stats – no two survivors play the same.


Wield an arsenal of iconic weapons drawn from the armouries of the far future and the mystical Mortal Realms. Eviscerate Tyranid hordes with a chainsword, or pulverise enemies with the unrelenting Bolter... and, if all that doesn’t work, drown them in a pot of Warhammer Paints  Nuln Oil paint.
Mix and match weapons with power-ups and evolve them into devastating new forms to create screen-clearing storms of bullets, blades and magic.

Obliterate the skittering, beady-eyed Skaven and their horde of warpstone-addled abominations or stand your ground against the ravenous Tyranid swarm and its myriads of monstrous Xenos bioforms.
Survive long enough, and you’ll encounter huge screen-filling bosses such as the mighty, monstrous Ghazghkull Thraka and Vizzik Skour,  Prophet of the Horned Rat. These are the deadliest threats and will require the right champion and loadout to beat!

Death is not the end for these champions of endless war. Survive for as long as you can against waves of enemies whilst collecting gold to grow more powerful for future runs. On the battlefield, you’ll also find Warhammer paint pots that will unlock new character forms and secrets.

title: over the hill
description:
Explore, navigate, and uncover the vast wilderness of over the hill, the newest installation from the creator of art of rally. Ramble your way through varied biomes inspired by real-world locations, from valleys to mountains and everything in between.

Take to the trails solo or with up to three friends. Cruise through scenic landscapes, tackle challenging off-road routes, and work together to overcome the obstacles standing between you and your destination.
Different situations call for different solutions. Use planks to cross gaps, deploy winches to recover vehicles and navigate difficult terrain, and bring the right equipment to help you overcome the challenges ahead. Whether you're carefully planning your route or improvising your way through a tricky situation, the journey is always in your hands.

Explore forests, lakesides, and mountains as you uncover remote cabins, scenic viewpoints, natural landmarks, meteorites that have fallen from the sky, and portals that can take you to new areas. Dynamic weather and day/night cycles can transform the world around you and change the conditions of your journey.

Spot native wildlife and use the in-game camera to document your discoveries. Photograph the animals you encounter to fill out your wildlife compendium, or stop to capture an awe-inspiring landscape, a beautiful sunset, or any other moment worth remembering.

Find upgrades and equipment throughout the world to help you take on the terrain ahead. Stop at merchants and cabins to customize your vehicle with colours, accessories, and cosmetics that suit your driving style.

This is a driving game, not a racing game. Take your time, enjoy the drive, find your own route, and see where the road leads. The best stories never start at the end.

title: Lost and Found Co.
description: Lost and Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of lively characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

title: Regions of Ruin: Runegate
description:
De la glorieuse civilisation naine, il ne reste que des ruines, des exilés dispersés aux quatre vents et des régions infestées de monstres. Embarquez pour une aventure mêlant exploration, RPG et hack'n'slash dans la peau d'un nain solitaire prêt à tout pour reconstruire un refuge pour son peuple et percer les mystères de ses ancêtres.

EXPLOREZ DE RICHES CONTRÉES

L'ancien royaume des nains est constitué de terres aussi vastes que diverses, pleines de ressources, d'alliés loyaux et d'ennemis redoutables. Traversez des environnements luxuriants, affrontez un temps capricieux, explorez des grottes remplies de cristaux chatoyants et plus encore dans votre quête de trésors et d'informations. Préparez-vous à combattre des ennemis implacables et bien décidés à exterminer définitivement les nains.

RESTAUREZ UNE COMMUNAUTÉ

Au cours de votre périple, vous rencontrerez des camarades nains en difficulté. Volez à leur secours, ralliez-les à votre cause et créez un havre de paix pour votre peuple en reconstruisant toute une civilisation. En amassant des ressources et en enrôlant d'autres aventuriers talentueux, vous débloquerez de nouvelles constructions et technologies qui vous permettront de progresser vers votre but.

VIVEZ UNE EXPÉRIENCE SUR MESURE

Créez votre propre héros nain en personnalisant son apparence et son style de combat. Expérimentez avec une variété d'équipements, d'armes et de compétences. Triomphez de chaque affrontement comme vous l'entendez : en chargeant lance à la main ou en frappant sournoisement votre cible dans le dos. Mais surtout, restez vigilant, car vos ennemis s'adapteront à vos actions !

title: Legends of the Round Table
description: Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom to make the flower of chivalry blossom again.

title: DAMON and BABY
description: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

title: Sintopia
description: Manage Hell. Manipulate the Overworld. Build the resurrection business of your dreams! In Sintopia, you’re tasked with managing the bureaucratic administration of Hell: “re-educate” the sinful, generate profit, play god and expand your hellish empire. All part of a day’s work at Hell Incorporated.

title: Haunted Lands
description:
Pénétrez dans Haunted Lands, un jeu d'action et de plateforme d'inspiration rétro rempli de secrets cachés et de défis infernaux. Choisissez parmi cinq personnages uniques, chacun correspondant à un style de jeu différent. Pénétrez dans de périlleux cimetières grouillants d'esprits maléfiques et d’abominations cauchemardesques. Obtenez de puissants artefacts pour affronter ces maux et trouvez de nouvelles façons d'aborder les batailles.


Principales caractéristiques

Des héros uniques : Choisissez l'un des cinq personnages jouables. Certains préfèrent abattre les monstres à distance, tandis que d'autres excellent dans le combat rapproché. Chacun a ses propres capacités et son propre style de jeu.
Des lieux dangereux : Explorez les ruines des anciennes cryptes et tombes remplies d'esprits maléfiques et de monstres d'outremonde. Frayez-vous un chemin à travers des hordes d'ennemis, leurs versions d'élite et des boss redoutables.
De puissants artefacts : Obtenez des artefacts qui améliorent vos capacités et vous offrent de nouvelles façons d'affronter les monstruosités des cimetières. Les objets les plus puissants peuvent entièrement modifier les compétences de votre personnage.
Des défis pour les plus exigeants : Trouvez tous les secrets cachés Haunted Lands, remplissez tous les objectifs et ne laissez derrière vous que des cadavres. Oserez-vous descendre dans les abîmes de l'enfer pour en revenir indemne ?

title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
description: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

title: Painkiller RTX
description:
It's time to revisit purgatory. One man against the Underworld, wielding the most demented arsenal ever to grace a shooter.

The speed, the carnage and that unmistakable atmosphere: this is the cult classic that defined an era, now rebuilt from the ground up for modern RTX hardware.



Painkiller RTX uses NVIDIA RTX Remix with full-scene path tracing, rebuilt physically based rendering (PBR) materials, volumetric lighting and RTX Skin subsurface scattering to bring one of the most distinctive shooters ever made into stunning new light.

Developed by Merry Pencil Studios, awarded Best Overall in NVIDIA's 2025 RTX Remix Mod Contest.

What's been overhauled:
Full-scene path tracing with dynamic shadows and reflections
Thousands of legacy textures rebuilt as PBR materials
Hand-crafted lighting shaped to preserve Painkiller's signature atmosphere
Volumetric lighting bringing depth and drama to iconic environments
RTX Skin subsurface scattering on characters and surfaces

Please note: RTX Remix Painkiller is an ongoing work in progress covering chapters 1, 2 and 3 of the game.

title: Magical Blush Demo
description:
Magical Blush is coming soon and can be wishlisted
here
Explore the opening stages of a top-down Metroidvania adventure in the Magical Blush Demo, where fast-paced magical combat, branching paths and hidden secrets await. Master Arnin’s first set of elemental spells and get a glimpse of the shattered world of Wyn — and the power you’ll need to rewrite its fate.

About Magical Blush



EXPLORE a variety of magical stages in a top-down Metroidvania-style world filled with branching paths, hidden secrets, and rewards for revisiting previously explored locations.
FACE a wide range of enemies in fast-paced magical combat, from treacherous minions to cunning bosses.
MASTER a diverse arsenal of elemental spells, each with unique and scalable effects.
EQUIP Arnin with specialized gear to enhance her abilities and customize your playstyle.
UNLOCK special abilities that open new paths and help overcome complex challenges throughout the stages.
DISCOVER hidden stories scattered across the world to reveal the truth behind the chaos and unlock the game’s true ending.


Enhance Your Spells
Become more powerful by evolving your spells and unleashing their full potential!



Elemental System
Command the forces of Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, and Spirit. Each element has strengths, weaknesses, and neutralities — choosing the right spell at the right time is essential to survive.



Dynamic Exploration
Unlock new interconnected stages and secret paths as you progress. Every exit leads to a new destination — or back to familiar places with new possibilities.



Charming Minigames
Take a break from the chaos with minigames that offer fun challenges and worthwhile rewards!




When the world falls apart, rewrite it with magic.

Arnin is a powerful mage and guardian of the Elemental Lords. Upon returning from the astral plane, she discovers her world has been devastated. The Elemental Lords were unleashed by a mysterious figure and now threaten the land of Wyn.

Arnin must travel across her kingdom, save the survivors, and face the fury of fire, water, wind, stone, and spirit.
Chain powerful spells, command elemental forces, and uncover hidden secrets.

The fate of Wyn is in your hands!

title: R.I.P. - Reincarnation Insurance Program
description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Insurance Program! This top-down roguelite shooter blends Diablo-style looting with Survivor-like mayhem. Face screen-filling zombie tides, use Divine Tech to liquidate them into ash, and farm god-tier gear to forge your OP build.

title: Chef Knight
description: Chef Knight is a cozy fantasy incremental game where monsters aren’t just enemies – they’re ingredients.Dive into dangerous dungeons, defeat monsters to collect fresh ingredients, return to your kitchen to cook delicious meals, then sell your dishes to upgrade before your next run!Explore top-down dungeons filled with monsters both deadly & delicious. Aim your attacks, dodge dangerous traps, and unlock powerful culinary weapons to handle the darkest depths of the dungeon!Turn your spoils into scrumptious dishes back in the kitchen. Discover new ingredients, unlock recipes, and watch your monster cuisine grow from simple meals into highly sought-after delicacies!Sell your dishes to passing adventurers and reinvest the profits into powerful upgrades from a vast skill tree. Improve how fast you fight, how efficiently you cook, and how far you can push each run!

title: Beastro (2026)
description: Beastro is a cozy culinary adventure where the fate of the world rests on what's for dinner! Farm and gather fresh ingredients, tackle cooking minigames, and create tasty recipes to fuel the Caretakers for deckbuilding battles as they seek to save the world.

title: TR-49
description: A World War II computer. An archive of lost books. A world-changing secret. Narrative deduction meets audio drama, from the creators of Overboard!, Heaven's Vault and A Highland Song.

title: Pakinpaks
description: A cozy puzzle game where you go on a journey all around the world packing and organizing all sorts of travel gear. Fulfill your client's request in any way you wish and prepare the neatest bags that you can while making sure everything fits!

title: Vending Machine Co
description: Run your kawaii vending machine company! A relaxing sim where you manage, restock, and repair your vending machines across a charming Japanese city. Pick neighborhoods, stock up on snacks, set the perfect price, upgrade your machines. Enjoy lots of fun minigames along the way.

title: Dead Pets Unleashed
description:
Killer Soundtrack: A punk rock EP recorded just for Dead Pets and a ton of indie game crossovers.
Minigames for Days: Including working a shift at a diner (diner dash), rhythm games, and making hot dogs.
A Demon City filled with Life: New Void City is filled with lively friends and foes, all with their own inner lives.
Success is in Your Hands: Gordy's future and the band's fame rest in your hands. Choose your ending!
Cartoonish Inspirations: For fans of Bojack Horseman and Tuca and Bertie. Inspired by their colorful, surreal worlds, complicated, dynamic friendships, and zany, offbeat humor.
Manage Your Choices: Every choice affects Gordy's wellbeing, the band's power, her social points, or her bank account.


Gordy and her punk band, Dead Pets, have been playing together for… a while, and have never made it big. Heading into their 30s, their personal responsibilities and the band's uncertain future is looming over them. Do they have what it takes to give Dead Pets one last shot at success?


Dead Pets Unleashed is a feminist, management-lite, minigame-heavy, slice-of-life, narrative game; about music, friendship, and maturing. Playing as Gordy, you’ll go to band practice, manage Gordy’s finances, her wellbeing, and try to find enough time and money to cover... well, everything.
Gordy's life is a mess. Decide where Gordy’s priorities lie to shape the future of the band. With different endings, you'll have the chance to help Gordy grow in a ton of different ways.


Long-term friendships can be messy, especially when everyone grows up at their own pace. Can you stop a job, a relationship or a lifestyle from hurting the band?

On top of everything else, the band's first taste of success comes at the cost of Gordy’s mental health and physical wellbeing. Just how much is she willing to sacrifice for fame? Or for justice?


From the creators of Welcome to Elk, dive into the demon world of New Void City, and give your childhood dreams one last chance.
It’s time to get loud, grow up, and rock out.

title: I Eat Paintings When Guards Aren't Looking
description: Find hidden objects in famous paintings… then eat them. Decode bizarre cravings, rip chunks out of Renaissance masterpieces, and snack your way through art history like the absolute menace you are.

title: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse
description: A Metroidvania x Roguelite where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

title: Arms of God
description: Gear up for a battle through hell in this roguelite Bullet Heaven Arena Autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to a world on the brink of chaos.

title: How Many Dudes?
description: How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

title: Don't Stop, Girlypop!
description: Spread the love! Don’t Stop, Girlypop! is a Y2K arena movement shooter where standing still is not an option. ❤ Just ❤ Don’t ❤ Stop ❤ Moving! ❤

title: S.A.N.D.Y. - Beach Cleaner
description: Clean up trash from the beach in this short, relaxing, and grim game! Recycle waste, upgrade your robot. Explore new territories. Clean up oil spills and save the animals!

title: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
description:
Tukoni: Forest Keepers Demo is available
here.
Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.


Breathtaking storybook aesthetic
Immerse yourself in a magical hand-drawn forest world, inspired by the kind and nature-loving spirit of the world of Tukoni.

Quest to help Autumn
Autumn is a busy time in the forest, as animals wrap up their matters before taking a winter nap, and forest keepers Tukoni hustle to prepare pillows and blankets of various shapes and forms. As for the main character, he’s a Tukoni on a special mission.

Cast of whimsical characters
Meet a cast of whimsical characters, each with their own unique quirks and endearing traits.

Engaging puzzles & mini-games
Solve puzzles and get ready to be challenged to some captivating mini-games!

The Notebook is your guide
Your Notebook will offer guidance, help you solve puzzles, and document your adventures along the way.

Make fragrant tea
As the seasons change and the forest embraces the chill of autumn, take solace in the comforting ritual of brewing fragrant tea for your newfound friends.

Wholesome adventure for all ages
With its charming visuals and engaging gameplay, Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a family-friendly experience that both parents and children can enjoy together.

Cozy up with Tukoni
Whether it's a lazy afternoon or a chilly evening, Tukoni: Forest Keepers offers a cozy escape into a world of warmth and wonder, perfect for unwinding and embracing the simple joys of life.
