title: Stonemachia
description: Fight, Zefiro! Arm yourself with the power of chess and explore Medhelan, a land haunted by the Plague of Angels, in a dark action-adventure with soulslike elements. Will you be able to return to Heaven?

title: Ghost Buster Village
description: An extreme blogger travels to an abandoned village that, according to legend, was deserted in a single day. While exploring, he encounters rituals and entities rooted in Slavic mythology. But the truth waiting there is far more terrifying than any legend.

title: Drill And Delve
description: You've been trapped in a mine. You'll need to use your tools to dig your way to the exit in a fully destructible 3D voxel terrain. Manage your oxygen and equipment, and uncover the dark mystery buried deep within the mine.

title: A Bumpy Ride
description: Take a jaunt into the world of A Bumpy Ride, a cozy train-driving and exploration game! Inspired by railroading of the 19th century with a whimsical spin, you'll adventure around the open frontier in your trusty little train, picking up passengers and freight.

title: Relooted
description: Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

title: Pokémon Champions
description:
Get ready to experience everything you love about Pokémon battles all in one place—in Pokémon Champions. This new, battle-focused game will feature familiar mechanics such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves, creating an environment conducive to rich and varied strategies for new and experienced Trainers alike.
Make use of Pokémon types, Abilities, moves, and mechanics from previous games in the series, including Mega Evolution, as you develop rich and varied strategies on the road to victory.

title: Lumina Veil
description: Survival HorrorYou are LunatiiCreeps, a horror-loving streamer known for braving the darkest corners of the gaming world. You get exclusive access to this new strange game and decide to embark on a journey into the shadows of the mind with Lumina Veil.Classic horror with a modern twistA captivating horror experience that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying monstrosities, and use any tool necessary to fight for your life. Inspired by the horror classics, Lumina Veil offers an old school atmosphere with modern themes.A double lifeWhile exploring your new game as a streamer, you also live your real life, where the facade of normalcy masks a society grappling with isolation and control.Completely free solo projectLumina Veil will be a free game with zero monetization, developed by one person, aiming to give a nod to the classics.

title: Dice Hoarder
description:
You are the perfect fit for the job!
You've been hired to stock a mysterious dice shop. Pick them up, examine their colours and materials, and rebuild 400+ seven-piece dice sets. Each set needs one of every classic polyhedral die: a percentile die, D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, and D20.

Take All the Time You Need
There are no timers and no need to rush. In Story Mode, the next day begins only after you have stocked the required value of dice. Search every corner, plan your sets, and work at your own pace while a cozy ambience and relaxing original soundtrack accompany every shift.

Unlock New Skills
As the days pass, mysterious floppy disks begin to appear. Use them to unlock strange new powers that make your work easier. Track down the remaining dice needed to complete a set, or pull them directly into your hand as if by magic.

The disks are certainly useful. Who keeps leaving them for you is another question...
Who Hired You?
You were given a job, a shop full of scattered dice, and very little information about your employer. Keep completing your shifts, follow the clues left behind, and uncover the truth behind your unusual new workplace.

Key Features
• Cozy first-person organizing gameplay.

• Pick up and stock thousands of colorful dice.

• ASMR, satisfying click-clack dice sounds.

• Story Mode with shift-based progression and no timers.

• Mysterious floppy disks that unlock special sorting abilities.

• Uncover the mystery and the secrets behind the shop.

• Chill Mode for one uninterrupted, story-free organizing experience.

• Magical dice, cozy ambience, a relaxing original soundtrack, and a cat.

title: Piece by Piece (2026)
description: It's time to open shop! Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!

title: Eternal Afternoon
description: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.

title: NUTMEG! A Nostalgic Deckbuilding Football Manager
description: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

title: Extinction Day
description: End humanity using disasters, plagues, and war. Spread chaos worldwide, combine catastrophic events, and stop them before they escape to the Ark.

title: Too Well Hidden
description: A found footage horror game about two sisters who often play hide and seek in their family home, recording everything with their mother's VHS camera. What begins innocently, soon turns disturbing, when it becomes clear that something is terribly wrong.

title: Timber Rush
description: Timber Rush is a fast-paced incremental roguelite where every swing explodes into upgrades, chaos, and massive numbers.

title: The Ratline
description: A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.

title: Echo Generation 2
description: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Build your crew, master powerful decks, and uncover the truth behind a growing cosmic threat. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.

title: Order Automatica
description:
La démo de Order Automatica est disponible ici.
A dark roguelike auto battler played on a 3×3 ritual grid. Position your units, combine cursed relics, and unleash powerful synergies before the last candle burns out.
Recruit strange allies, position them with care, and empower them with occult artifacts to survive each battle.Every run brings new enemies, unpredictable events, and the chance to uncover the true purpose of the ritual.
Simple rules. Infinite strategies.
Order Automatica’s battles are fought automatically — your job is to prepare. Spend your gold, place units on the grid, and combine them with items, cell effects, and indulgences to create unstoppable synergies. Victory comes not just from raw strength, but from clever placement and timing. Dozens of ways to break the game.
Unlock a growing roster of unique units, powerful items, and battlefield effects.
Experiment with countless combinations to outsmart increasingly dangerous enemies. Lose all your candles and the ritual resets — but with every run, you learn new ways to bend the rules.
Key Features:Tactical battles on a 3×3 grid with a unique roguelike progression systemDeep synergies and clever unit placement as the key to victoryA dark tale of an order and occult rituals full of hidden mysteriesMultiple game modes offering fresh challenges and virtually endless replayabilityDistinct pixel art and a haunting, hypnotic soundtrack that sets the mood Can you complete the ritual… or will it consume you?

title: Snap & Grab
description: Do crimes using only your camera and your crew! In Snap & Grab, any photo you take could be the key to cool crime success. Travel to exotic sandbox locations, photograph treasures and reveal threats, then combine your photos in unique ways to create a rad heist plan.

title: Perfect Tides: Station to Station
description: A narrative adventure about the momentum and whiplash of young adulthood. Explore the big city through 18-year-old Mara's eyes. Collect items, nurture ideas, and experience complex relationships while attempting to find your place in the world.

title: Insider Trading
description: Insider Trading is a roguelike deckbuilder about trading stocks. Immerse yourself in the rhythmic flow of charts, and break the market with synergizing perks and cards.

title: Coincidences?
description: After a sudden rent hike, you move into a suspiciously cheap house deep in the woods. The price is absurdly low and there’s work nearby-it seems like a stroke of luck. But you soon realize something is seriously wrong with the place...

title: A Planet Full of Cats
description: A Planet Full of Cats is a hidden object adventure with metroidvania-style exploration in true Devcats fashion. Explore diverse biomes, unlock new powers and uncover ancient secrets!

title: Treasure Beach
description: Scavenge the beach and run a cozy trinket shop by the sea! Find hidden treasures or trash, clean and repair your finds, put them up for sale, and upgrade your workshop. Dig deeper and faster to make more money and buy back the beach from the greedy hotel.

title: Elementallis
description:
Amend your actions. Restore the Elements

The Elements have gone wild and the world is now in danger. Driven by guilt, you embark on a journey to restore them all and conquer the temples where each Element resides. Solve puzzles, fight foes and find secrets using the Elements you've gathered.


Features
Real-Time Combat
Fight enemies using the Elements, alongside your sword and shield. Combine Fire, Water, Electricity, and more to exploit their weaknesses and overcome tough encounters.

Challenging Temples
Prove your worth in the 8 unique temples, full of puzzles, secrets, dangerous foes and fun boss battles.

Explore and Discover
Travel and explore the 8 unique biomes. They are full of secrets, upgrades and inhabitants in need of your help.

Elemental Progression
Restore the Elements and unlock their abilities to open up new locations, solve puzzles and access previously inaccessible areas.

Overcome guilt
Experience a story of self-discovery and the journey to heal a broken world and a broken self.

title: Duck Side of the Moon
description: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

title: Forage Wizard
description: Click, craft and collect your way to alchemical mastery. Progress through a branching skill tree and explore the forbidden woods. Collect resources and build machines of magic. Slay monsters, farm crops and automate your production to become the all-powerful Forage Wizard!

title: Out of the Park Baseball 27
description: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 27 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! You are firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise - today or at any point in history! Your team, your way, your rules.

title: LUCKROT
description: Roguelike shooter set in a dystopian, livestreamed gameshow. Obliterate waves of deformed freaks, earn donations from your sadistic audience and gamble your earnings for upgrades. Your life is a Performance. Your Death is Content.

title: SPORTAL
description:
Battes, balles, boules, bottes...Dans ce FPS roguelike rétro sur le thème du sport, vous êtes happé dans un portail et émergez avec tout un vestiaire d'équipements sportifs reconvertis en armes fatales pour lutter contre une ménagerie horrifique.

- Utilisez une panoplie d’équipements sportifs pour terrasser les hordes de monstres tout droit sorties des films de monstres des années 50 :balles de baseball en métal lourdes, palets de hockey électrisants, tourelles à boules de bowling, balles de golf élémentaires qui gèlent, enflamment ou terrifient tout ce qui se met en travers de leur chemin… et bien plus encore !


- Discutez avec le gars du bocal, une tête bizarre qui vous servira de guide et vous aidera à prendre vos marques tout en enchaînant les blagues (que vous ayez envie de les entendre ou non).


- Trouvez et améliorez de nombreux clubs, battes, crosses et balles, tenues et avantages pour trouver les combinaisons gagnantes : elles ne vous seront pas de trop si vous voulez éliminer toutes les monstruosités qui jalonnent votre chemin et espérer rentrer un jour chez vous.


Caractéristiques :
8 armes sportives de base et plus de 120 améliorations meurtrières au total
Plus de 100 bonus : sacs à dos, épaulières, bottes et masques
6 environnements et des dizaines d'arènes qui fleurent bon la série B
19 types de monstres de film et 5 boss impitoyables
De l’humour noir, des démembrements rétro et un carnage satisfaisant
19 pistes qui envoient du lourd pendant vos parties chaotiques
Un style rétro pixélisé qui multiplie les hommages aux années 50

title: Ultratap
description: ULTRATAP is an incremental game about defeating monsters and bosses, getting stronger and enjoying the process. Buy upgrades, complete quests and equip powerful items.

title: Voidling Bound
description: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

title: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand Demo
description:
Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand arrive bientôt sur GOG.com. Vous pouvez l'ajouter à votre liste de souhaits
ici
À propos du jeu

Rassemblez votre courage dans la peau d'Aya, une chasseuse novice qui a rejeté la vie à la ferme pour partir à la recherche d'un nouveau foyer, de découvertes et d'aventures !

Mais chaque nouveau voyage réserve son lot de dangers mortels... Une faune sauvage, des maraudeurs, des monstres ! Sans oublier le regard sévère de Nailah, une courtisane célèbre dont le nom est connu dans des contrées lointaines, et qui est désormais votre employeuse. Aya possède les outils et les compétences nécessaires pour chasser, mais son attitude impétueuse et impulsive pourrait bien lui jouer des tours.
Découvrez Gold and Sand du Team Dead Deer. Un CRPG érotique qui se déroule deux ans avant Price for Freedom: Avarice et 85 ans avant notre série de bandes dessinées en ligne, avec une histoire solide axée sur les personnages.



Dans la peau d'Aya, aventurez-vous à Kaldea pour réaliser votre rêve de devenir une chasseuse acclamée au sein de la célèbre guilde des chasseurs de la ville. Mais Kaldea est autant une opportunité qu'une épreuve, une cité-État indépendante, sauvage et indomptée, à l'image des bêtes qu'Aya a choisi de chasser. En tant que solitaire, elle aura peut-être du mal à trouver ses marques dans ce monde brutal.

Avec Nailah, une femme qui suit un chemin très différent, Aya se retrouve contrainte de travailler pour elle et unies par l'adversité. Maîtresse dans l'art de la sociabilité, cette exotique chienne sauvage semble glisser sans effort à travers la vie. Son commerce de chair lui a apporté richesse, respect et renommée. Tous tombent sous son charme, tous sauf Aya, qui a du mal à accepter la différence de traitement que le monde leur réserve.


Désespérée, luttant pour sa survie et vulnérable, Aya rassemble toutes ses forces pour surmonter une situation mortelle. Cette histoire explore des personnages qui apprennent leurs limites et tirent parti de leurs forces. Connectez-vous avec les autres, apprenez à compter sur eux ! Ou choisissez de vous isoler et de repousser les autres. Dans cette aventure, vos choix façonneront la façon dont Aya réagit et est perçue par le monde tandis que vous interagissez avec nos personnages vivants et réalistes.



Un monde rempli de cultures et de peuples merveilleux, d'une profondeur rarement vue en dehors des anciens jeux de rôle sur ordinateur ! L'équipe Dead Deer est fière de la construction minutieuse de son univers. Explorez la savane et quelques villages le long de la côte d'Atlathkan et découvrez notre monde vivant.


Un monde complet avec des aventures, des dangers, des amitiés... et de la passion ! Alors qu'Aya explore son monde et sa nouvelle vie, elle découvrira également les aspects sensuels de l'existence. Romance, flirt, sexe. Gold and Sand embrasse tous les aspects de l'aventure adulte en s'inspirant de certaines des plus grandes histoires de tous les temps. Guiderez-vous Aya vers une aventure passionnée d'un soir ou vers une romance tendre et naissante ? Le tempérament d'Aya n'est pas la seule chose qui s'emballe. La chasseuse peut avoir du mal à nouer des liens avec les autres, ce qui peut également pousser ses passions à éclater dans des scènes animées et scintillantes.


Explorez la savane, les villages, les villes et les grottes de la campagne kaldéenne tout en découvrant les personnages de cet univers de différentes manières. Nous nous sommes efforcés de vous offrir autant de liberté que possible dans Gold and Sand. Des choix lourds de conséquences qui influencent vos interactions avec les autres et un système de combat brutal ! Des arbres de compétences et la gestion de l'inventaire avec une multitude de contenus secondaires et de mini-jeux !


Nos environnements dessinés à la main avec beaucoup d'amour et de détails, regorgent de secrets et de choses à découvrir. Objets, grimoires, créatures et villages. Avec les illustrations du célèbre Arbuz Budesh et d'autres talents incroyables de notre équipe artistique, comme Etherek et ZlaSova, ce jeu et son univers vous offriront une expérience unique.


Aya et Nailah ne sont pas les seuls personnages de cet univers. Des chasseurs chevronnés, une tribu d'ogres et même quelques caméos d'Avarice. Certains des passés des personnages d'Avarice seront révélés et vous découvrirez comment ils sont liés à ceux de Gold and Sand. Mais vous découvrirez des secrets d'Aya et Nailah propres à cette aventure qui pourraient mettre beaucoup de choses en perspective.


Des scènes entièrement animées avec nos personnages très travaillés donnent du poids et de l'impact à chaque rencontre. Chacune étant liée aux événements de l'histoire et à notre narration, nous donnons du sens et de la saveur à chaque scène. D'une chasseuse fougueuse à une courtisane aeylish à la peau sombre, les occasions érotiques ne manquent pas dans notre univers.


Découvrez notre interprétation unique du combat au tour par tour avec trois personnages principaux, dont Aya en tête ! Une chasseuse de bêtes polyvalente que vous pouvez façonner pour remplir le rôle dont vous avez besoin. Nailah, bien que courtisane, est prête à jouer un rôle de soutien au combat et pourrait bien révéler des talents inattendus au-delà du boudoir. Qui pourrait être notre troisième personnage ? Jouez pour le découvrir !

Nous avons cherché à explorer ce que nous étions capables de réaliser avec ce projet. Bon nombre de ces développements sont des expérimentations en vue de notre entrée dans la cour des grands et nous permettent de nous faire les dents sur des contenus plus modestes.



Gold and Sand est un projet annexe qui peut également être joué de manière indépendante. Se déroulant deux ans avant Avarice, il met en scène plusieurs personnages de notre projet principal. Découvrez comment ils sont devenus les personnages que vous connaissez et appréciez depuis des années dans Gold and Sand !

title: Magical Blush
description:
Magical Blush DEMO is available
here.


EXPLORE a variety of magical stages in a Metroidvania-esque world filled with branching paths, hidden secrets, and rewarding backtracking.
BATTLE a wide array of enemies in fast-paced magical combat, from tricky minions to cunning bosses.
MASTER a diverse arsenal of elemental spells, each with unique effects and upgrade potential with the Combo Counter.
EQUIP Arnin with specific gear to enhance your abilities and customize your playstyle.
UNLOCK special abilities that open new paths and help conquer complex level challenges.
UNCOVER hidden lore scattered across the world to reveal the truth behind the chaos and unlock the game's true ending.





Enhance your spells


Become more powerful by evolving your spells, unleashing their full potential.





Elemental System
Harness the forces of Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, and Spirit. Each element has strengths, neutrality and weaknesses, so smart spell choices and timing are key to survival.

Charming minigames
Step away from the chaos for a spell with minigames that offer fun challenges and worthwhile rewards!

Chain powerful spells, command elemental forces, and uncover the secrets.

title: The Mermaid Mask
description: A murder in a locked room that seems impossible! On board his own submarine, Captain Mortuga is killed, and all the guests are under suspicion! A witty and stylish point-and-click quest with exciting puzzles! Solve a new mystery from the creators of Tangle Tower and Crow Country!

title: Moldwasher
description: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

title: Galactic Vault
description: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

title: The Big Number
description: The Big Number is a strategic incremental idle clicker where you breach 17 massive firewalls to reach infinity. Start from zero and build your way to unimaginable numbers through tactical resource management, automated systems, and strategic progression.

title: Card Coder
description: Card Coder is a card-building roguelike: A novel mix of tactical card battles, inventory management and roguelike deckbuilding, where YOU create custom cards during play. Loot, shop & collect modular ability components to make truly unique cards out of 10 billion possibilities.

title: In Their Shoes (2026)
description: From the first day of spring, to the last day of winter, wear seven shoes of seven characters and live their most intimate moments. Explore their thoughts, choose their steps and shape their paths in a mumblecore narrative game where the most extraordinary setting is ordinary life itself.

title: Docked
description: Return home to Port Wake and rebuild your family business. Docked is a realistic, task-driven simulator where you operate heavy machinery, restore and develop the port's infrastructure, and manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive.

title: Dead Weight (2026)
description: Face the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on a roguelite adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search of loot. Choose a class and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

title: Maseylia: Echoes of the past
description: Explore a fully interconnected 3D world where every new ability dramatically expands your freedom. A true non-linear Metroidvania with breathtaking movement, atmospheric sci-fi beauty, and deep environmental storytelling.

title: Sushi Simulator (2026)
description: Manage your own sushi restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh sushi, purchase ingredients, manage stock, and keep your customers happy. No distractions, just a focused single-player sushi simulation.

title: Cleaning Up!
description: Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of restoring them to order with your super-powered cleaning tools. This is a short and simple game about the joy of tidying up!

title: HYPNOS (2026)
description: HYPNOS is a first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Embrace your destiny.

title: Astro Burn Demo
description:
Astro Burn is coming soon and can be wishlisted
here

Blast through bullet-hell with Astro, the fearless space cat, and her robot buddy AL!

Astro Burn is our love letter to the early ’90s cute-em-up classics like Parodius and Pop’n TwinBee — games that were bold, wildly creative, and completely, delightfully bonkers!


In this demo of Astro Burn, you play as Astro — a daredevil feline astronaut strapped into a high-powered jetpack — and her trusty robot sidekick AL as they return from a deep-space mission to discover Earth has been overtaken by colossal, cute-but-chaotic overlord animals… and not a single human in sight.

What’s in the Demo?

🎮 1 Arcade Level — classic shoot-’em-up action, fur-real!
👾 1 End-of-Level Boss — bigger, badder, and claw-challenging.
🐾 1 Co-op Level — because two cats fight better than one!
💊 Power-Ups Galore — Health, Ammo, Shields, plus the time-bending Catnip Mode (bullet-time in space, meow-yeah!).
🔫 Fur-midable Weapons — spreader blasters, grenades, and more to paw-er up your arsenal.
📦 Stack-’Em-Up Weapon System — keep collecting, keep clawing through enemies.
🎓 Tutorial (optional) — purr-fect for new space cadets.
📖 Discord Leaderboard — Flex your scores and fastest time on each run via the Discord connection feature.
Local Leaderboard - Claw your way to the top of the local leaderboard with classic 3 initials to your name.

🐱✨ This is bullet-hell with serious cat-titude. Do you have the nine lives it takes to save Earth?

title: Brigador Killers Demo
description:
Brigador Killers is coming soon and can be wishlisted
here
Demo contains two campaigns called OBSTACLE 1 and THE GARAGE. OBSTACLE 1 introduces the mechanics with some short narrative beats that takes about 15 minutes to complete. THE GARAGE is a sandbox focused on deploying on increasingly difficult missions to acquire arsenal upgrades, vehicles, parts and weapons that can take several hours to fully complete.

Simulateur insurrectionnel en vue isométrique. Combattez à pied ou à bord d'engins, constituez ou volez votre arsenal privé et allez buter ces gros bourges qui nous l'ont mise bien profond.


Vous appartenez à la Team Anchor, déployée sur la planète d'origine du SNC dans le but de les faire payer pour ce qu'ils nous ont fait.


Patrouillez à pied dans Mar Nosso ou enfoncez les défenses locales avec votre blindé.


Procurez-vous et utilisez plus de 30 armes à feu, du pistolet bricolé de Corvid nossiens au dernier cri en matière de flingue Spacien.
Améliorez votre arsenal en trouvant différentes armures de combats.
Récupérez des épaves pour les pièces afin de vous fabriquer de nouveaux engins de mort.
Montez des armes sur vos nouvelles créations et allez à la pouille avec.
Explorez des univers ultra détaillés à bord des vielles bagnoles défoncées, de tanks ou de mechs bipèdes.
Profitez d'une bande son originale composée par le célèbre Makeup And Vanity Set.
Brisez le monopole de Mar Nosso en butant des Brigadors.

Brigador Killers est actuellement en développement et arrivera prochainement.

title: Celsius Strays Demo
description:
Celsius Strays arrive bientôt sur GOG.com. Vous pouvez l'ajouter à votre liste de souhaits ici.


Vous êtes le Chef des Squealers.

Neuf années se sont écoulées depuis l’échec du coup d’État censé sauver votre peuple, et votre bannissement dans un recoin oublié des Slums. Ici, survivre est un luxe : escadrons de la mort robotiques, climat meurtrier et Seigneurs des Slums avides de pouvoir n’attendent qu’une chose : anéantir le reste des rats rebelles.

Gérez votre équipe, protégez votre colonie, soyez un leader. Et souvenez-vous : dans un monde qui vous est hostile, tous les dangers ne viennent pas de l’extérieur.

Il s’agit d’un Visual Novel interactif, avec quelques énigmes, et où les choix que vous faites et les relations que vous nouez façonnent l’avenir de l’histoire.
Caractéristiques
Plus de 200 portraits de personnages uniques, dessinés à la main, avec synchronisation labiale animée
Des dizaines de lieux interactifs vous menant dans les recoins encore inexplorés d’Atlasia
Illustrations cinématiques
Déterminez quel type de leader vous serez grâce à des choix significatifs qui impactent l’histoire principale et façonnent l’avenir des Squealers
Envoyez votre équipe en mission pour récolter des ressources, explorer de nouveaux lieux et renforcer les liens entre ses membres
Doublage de chaque personnage, avec des performances complètes lors des moments clés de l’histoire et des cinématiques
Bande-son entièrement originale
Bonus déblocables, incluant illustrations conceptuelles, modificateurs de jeu, et plus encore

Développé avec le moteur BROKVN, gratuit et accessible au public.

title: After the Wane Demo
description:
After the Wane arrive bientôt sur GOG.com. Vous pouvez l'ajouter à votre liste de souhaits
ici


Le nouveau roman graphique interactif par les créateurs d'Along the Edge et Across the Grooves.

Lena est une jeune danseuse avec des étoiles plein les yeux et de grands rêves. Cependant, dès qu'elle pose le pied dans la capitale, elle se retrouve prise au centre d'une querelle de clocher entre Fernand, le mystérieux directeur d'une maison de quartier et Déborah, la directrice d'une compagnie de danse élitiste qui a élu domicile dans un étrange théâtre. Tout cela a-t-il un lien quelconque avec sa mère, également danseuse, qui l'a abandonnée à la naissance ?
Tiraillée entre son passé et son futur, Lena va devoir se rappeler de sa propre nature et tracer son chemin, tandis que des événements de plus en plus étranges se produisent autour d'elle… Le plus bizarre restant l'omniprésence d'une voix dans sa tête qu'elle semble être la seule à entendre.


Forgez votre propre destinée : rejoignez une compagnie de danse élitiste, créez des liens avec les habitants et les jeunes danseurs et danseuses du quartier au centre associatif ou choisissez l'indépendance tout en cultivant votre attrait pour l'occulte.
Animations en rotoscopie : faites l'expérience de plusieurs scènes de danse au long de l'histoire, entièrement réalisées à la main.
Une aventure sur mesure : à chaque nouvelle partie, découvrez un roman illustré par des centaines d'images créées spécialement pour le jeu.
Une bande-son immersive et orchestrale : la musique, composée et enregistrée spécialement pour le jeu, change et s'adapte en fonction de vos choix et de l'ambiance de chaque scène.
Une grande rejouabilité : découvrez les conséquences de vos choix au travers des multiples embranchements et dénouements de l'histoire.

title: Cult Nation
description: A short incremental game about sacrificing all your cult followers and collecting blood to awaken the devil.

title: Demon Lord: Just a Block
description: Seek revenge on fantasy heroes as a reborn Demon Lord! Dive into this satisfying roguelite action game where the world only moves when you do. Plan your moves step by step or play swiftly with quick dodges and parries, colliding with enemies to land powerful attacks!

title: Allogloom
description:
Join Nora on a strange and unsettling journey of discovery in this point-and-click adventure by solo developer Galactic Ghosty. Something is abducting the residents of Gruesome Grove, and bringing them home means uncovering secrets some of the town would rather keep buried.
With a note pointing her somewhere forbidden as her only clue, Nora must piece together what happened and why, before there's no one left to save. She'll encounter the town's revered (and ravenous) moths, and navigate the displaced monsters left wandering the wreckage of her home. The deeper she goes, the less certain it is she'll make it out with everyone she loves.
The Gruesome Grove she grew up in has gone. To bring it back, she'll have to break every rule standing in her way.


A hand-crafted point-and-click adventure, inspired by the classics
A lush, detailed world brought to life through art nouveau-inspired illustration
A charming cast of characters, human, monster, and animal alike
Combine items and negotiate with characters to solve inventive puzzles
An intriguing story full of twists and turns, laced with dark humour
An original soundtrack by Kim Miller

title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
description: Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. Play through authentic movie moments in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

title: Blood Dungeon
description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

title: Project Songbird
description: Project Songbird is a first-person cinematic narrative psychological horror game from Conner Rush and his studio FYRE Games, the developer behind the critically praised games Summerland and We Never Left (from Dread X Collection 5). Take control of Dakota, a career musician who, amidst writer's block, decides to isolate themself in a cabin in the remote Appalachian forest in order to record their next album. Take in this gripping tale, explore the natural environment and haunting dreamscapes, and fight to survive in this short horror experience.

title: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel
description: When the sun shines on the Lap of the Gods, it is blood red. And when it rains, the sky sobs. Explore a strange world populated by even stranger beings in this story-driven adventure as Marion attempts to undo a mistake on a universal level, before everything she has ever known becomes Undone.

title: Factory Balls Go!
description: In this clever logic puzzle, craft each ball using the right tools. Yes, the classic Factory Balls puzzle game is back with fresh ideas. And this time, the balls might even have arms and legs, welcome to Factory Balls Go!

title: Mining Merchant
description: Mining Merchant is a relaxing mining and shopkeeping adventure game. Mine by day to uncover rare ores and gems, then craft jewelry to sell in your shop by night. Rebuild your uncle’s business solo or in co-op and uncover the mystery behind the nightly earthquakes.

title: All Hail the Orb
description: All Hail The Orb is a short, quirky pixel-art incremental game about powering a mysterious orb, summoning cultists, exploring a dungeon and slowly unlocking automation as devotion builds. The tone is light-hearted and a little silly with no fail states, relaxed pacing, and yes...many, many ducks.

title: Simultree
description: Simultree is a short incremental game about monitoring life simulations. You're a scientist who runs life simulations in order to gain points to spend in a big skill tree.

title: The Big Hollow: 1982
description:
It's 1982, and in a small truck stop community where everybody knows everybody, Ida and Bonnie's disappearances left questions that no one dared to ask out loud. For the FBI, where the term 'serial killer' is as new as their Behavioral Science Unit, this case isn’t just about murder—it's a test of whether these monsters can really be mapped.


You are Desmond, methodical and intuitive, learning the art of criminal profiling under Lenore Davidson, the cold, exacting representative of the BSU. Your insights could prove the unit’s worth—or expose its limitations.

Ida and Bonnie’s case is full of fragments, contradictions, and unfolding secrets. To solve it, you must decipher the why behind the crime, shaping Lenore’s impression of your potential as a profiler. Interpret what you see, uncover the meaning, and find your killer.

FEATURES:

A tightly focused 2.5 to 3 hour case that tells a deep, atmospheric story in the 1980s American South,
Explore a gritty setting beautifully illustrated with a unique 2D art style,
Examine evidence using techniques inspired by FBI thought processes and procedure,
Interpret evidence as you see fit, and influence the outcome of the investigation,
Experience a gradual and natural expansion of evidence and complexity

For fans of true crime, puzzles, and modernized 2D point-and-click adventures alike, The Big Hollow: 1982 is about deduction through a grounded, cinematic lens: The Case of the Golden Idol meets The Silence of the Lambs.

title: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
description: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

title: EmberVille
description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

title: Dungeons of DUSK Demo
description:
Dungeons of DUSK is coming soon
and can be wishlisted
here.
Experience the Dungeons of DUSK demo today!

Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS.Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS.


A 30 LEVEL CAMPAIGN WITH CHARACTER PROGRESSION AND NPCS
ENDLESS ARENA MODE TO TEST YOUR METTLE
BOSS RUSH MODE TO TEST YOUR WITS
SURVIVAL MODE TO TEST YOUR SANITY
NEW ENEMIES TO MESS WITH YOUR HEAD
FAMILIAR FOES TO EAT YOUR LEAD
THIS IS DUSK RPG... are you... WORTHY?

title: Crimson Moon (2026)
description: You are Nephilim: a human-angel hybrid forged to defend humanity with supernatural powers. Fight solo or with a friend to annihilate demons and challenge brutal bosses in relentless melée combat. Rise, violent one. The prophecy is yours to fulfill.

title: Exodus
description:
In EXODUS, Earth has been invaded, and it's up to CPL CHAI to hold the line at Facility 45 against the endless waves of Zephari alien invaders.
Tear through enemy hordes with powerful weapons, call in airstrikes, and upgrade your gear for Earth's future.
-Fast-paced 2D top-down shooter gameplay
-Day/Night cycles with weather effects
-Multiple alien enemy types with unique behaviors
-Weapon upgrades and purchasable support items
-Wave-based defense[
/list]
This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

title: The Killing Stone
description: Beat the Devil at his own game. The Killing Stone is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century occult horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

title: MOONROT
description: MOONROT is a short horror game about piloting a rover across a distant alien moon. Take grainy photos, record crackly signals, keep your battery charged, and uncover the source of the anomaly that led you here.

title: Hack And Climb!
description:
*Be the weapon! Swing like an axe, thrust like a spear, and soar like an arrow in this physics-based platformer. Flip, throw, and carve your path to the peak! Rage burns, revenge awaits... Are you up to the challenge?*

# HACK AND CLIMB

**CURSED** into **STEEL** and cast into the **ABYSS**...

**HE** left you to **RUST**...

Instead you **CLIMB**, one spiteful **THROW** at a time...

Your **RISE** will be his **DOWNFALL**....

**Hack And Climb** is a **physics-based** platformer where you play as a **cursed axe** on a grueling ascent in search of revenge.          

# MASTER THE AXE

Wield your tool with **precision**. **Every** throw is a **risk**, every landing a **triumph**. Miss your mark and pay the price.

# UNLOCK NEW WEAPONS

Claim up to 10 unique weapons! Each of them with their own quirks and challenges!

# CONQUER THE CLIMB

Explore breathtaking and untamed environments. Swing through ancient mines, navigate rain-slicked forests, and brave the freezing storms of the mountain.             

With a combination of precise, skill-based gameplay and beautiful, atmospheric environments **Hack And Climb** is a game that anyone can play, but only few can master.

# Key Features

- Physics-based Platforming: Master the art of throwing and climbing with your axe.
- 10 Unlockable Weapons: Discover new ways to conquer "The Climb" as you progress. 
- Challenging but Fair: Each stage tests your skills while rewarding persistence.
- Stunning Landscapes: Explore breathtaking, untamed environments each with unique mechanics. 
- "Hard" and "Legendary" Difficulties: Reaching the peak is just the beginning.

title: FRONT MISSION 3: Remake
description:
La démo de FRONT MISSION 3: Remake est disponible
ici
Le classique du RPG tactique fait son grand retour !
FRONT MISSION 3: Remake est le troisième chapitre de la saga emblématique, adorée par les fans du monde entier. Incarnez Kazuki et Ryogo alors que les tensions montent dans des zones militaires instables. Le destin de toute une région est entre vos mains : prenez le contrôle de puissants Wanzers et menez votre escouade à travers des combats intenses au tour par tour.

HISTOIRE

FRONT MISSION 3: Remake est un RPG tactique qui se déroule dans un futur où des nations et des entreprises se battent pour dominer un monde façonné par des mechas puissants appelés Wanzers.
Le jeu présente deux lignes narratives qui se divisent en fonction d’un choix précoce du protagoniste, Kazuki Takemura. Les deux histoires sont centrées sur une conspiration mondiale impliquant des armes secrètes, la cupidité des corporations et des agendas nationalistes.
L’histoire débute lorsque Kazuki et son meilleur ami Ryogo se retrouvent, sans le savoir, impliqués dans un conflit militaire après une livraison de routine à une base. Selon le choix du joueur, Kazuki rejoindra soit sa sœur Alisa, soit Emma Klamsky, une agente enquêtant sur un projet d'arme top secret appelé M.I.D.A.S.
Dans les deux routes, des thèmes comme la loyauté, la famille et l’éthique de la technologie sont explorés alors que Kazuki et son équipe luttent pour découvrir la vérité et éviter des conséquences catastrophiques.

CARACTÉRISTIQUES

• Deux histoires captivantes – Plongez dans deux récits immersifs influencés par vos choix, chacun offrant des perspectives et des défis uniques.
• Graphismes et animations améliorés – Redécouvrez le jeu avec des visuels modernisés et des animations plus fluides.
• Bande-son réorchestrée – Laissez-vous emporter par une nouvelle version de la bande originale culte.
• Personnalisation des camouflages des Wanzers – Donnez un style unique à vos Wanzers grâce à de nouvelles options de camouflage.
• Nouveau mode Combat rapide – Lancez-vous directement dans l’action avec ce mode de combat rapide et dynamique.

title: Atre: Dominance Wars
description:
La démo de Atre: Dominance Wars est disponible

ici

Atre: Dominance Wars est un jeu de stratégie en temps-réel 4X avec une pincée de mécaniques propres au style God-Game. Il offre une nouvelle perspective de son genre : monde dynamique original, des espèces uniques et un travail d'enquête basé sur le lore. Devenez un Ancien tout-puissant, poursuivez votre Ascension et conquérez un monde en proie à une magie sombre à laquelle seul vous pouvez mettre fin... si vous êtes capable de lever le voile sur la Vérité.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ironward/atre-dominance-wars
Dirigez vos armées et Métamorphosez vos unités
Recherchez des mutations pour vos unités et transformez vos armées afin d'oblitérer toute vie sur votre passage.
Développements vos colonies
Édifiez des villes prospères, construisez des bâtiments spéciaux et amassez des légions de fidèles dévots.
Faites pleuvoir vos sorts tel un Dieu
En tant qu'Ancien, poursuivez vos recherches magiques et découvrez de nombreux pouvoirs s'étendant de la prospérité pour vos cités à l'annihilation totale de vos ennemis. Les Anciens les plus puissants peuvent prétendre à l'Ascension et ouvrir la Porte séparant les mondes. Pendant cette période, vous détenez un pouvoir absolu et une magie qui pourrait bien détruire votre monde... mais ce pouvoir a un prix et la Porte reste accessible à de puissantes entités tapies de l'autre côté...
Forgez des Artefacts
Tirez profit de vos connaissances en enchantements afin d'utiliser des gemmes pour créer de puissants artefacts uniques pouvant octroyer à votre armée ou vous-même une puissance inégalée. Nommez ces artefacts selon votre bon désir en ayant recours à l'ancien dialecte Glagolitic.
Avatars – Les généraux Éternels
Cadeaux des Dieux, les généraux Éternels prendront la tête de vos armées en votre nom. Chaque victoire les fera gagner en expérience, charge à vous des les faire évoluer, de les équiper de vos meilleurs artefacts et d'en faire de formidables machines de destruction.
Étendez vous et explorez
Laissez votre Envoyé explorer ces terres ravagées et conquérez les grâce à vos Avatars. Faites main basse sur des cités, érigez des monolithes infusés de magie et établissez un empire régi par votre seule volonté.
Vos choix affectent le Monde
La manière dont le monde est généré prend en compte les caractéristiques magiques que vous attribuez à votre personnage. De cette façon, le monde est dépendant de vos choix dès les premiers instants. Les événements auxquels vous serez confrontés suivent la même règle et dépendront des statistiques votre personnage. Attention cependant, ces événements sont profondément imprégnés du lore de ce nouveau monde et face à de multiples choix, vous pourriez bien subir des conséquences inattendues si vous n'avez pas mené votre petite enquête.
Grâce à cette mécanique, Atre : Dominance Wars vous promet une expérience unique propre à chacune de vos parties.

title: One Move Away
description: One Move Away is a 3D, first-person puzzle game that blends puzzles with packing vehicles. Players experience packing at various stages of life, each level offering their own challenges. Master the art of packing by completing every objective!

title: Vortica
description: Vortica is a 2D action roguelite set in a solar system overrun by hostile aliens. Loot up, suit up, and shoot up as you battle against enemy hordes, explore derelict outposts, and hunt giant bosses. But remember to bring the right tools for the job!

title: FodFru
description:
FodFru™ is a 3D platformer video game developed by Néo Foderé de Frutos under the brand NSTUDIOS GAMES™, a division of FODSOFT™.

In this game, you step into the shoes of the fodfrus, a spherical-shaped alien species that can change color at will. This species is building an amusement park inspired by planet Earth. The problem is that several parts are missing from the main attraction’s mechanism, so your fodfru is one of the chosen ones tasked with finding the remaining pieces to complete the final ride and open the park.

title: Bunny’s Rent-a-Mom Agency
description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

Medium-length visual novel with multiple heroines
Lush artwork, generous event scenes, and 2D anime-style sprites
Warm hugs, a clean apartment, and sagely motherly advice
Fully voiced by a veteran cast of professional Japanese VAs
STORY

After losing his mother a few years ago, Ayato Hirose has been living alone with his dad, Masa, until Masa is suddenly sent overseas for two months over summer break.
Worried about leaving Ayato alone, they turn to a trusted neighbor, Rinko Ninomiya, for help. She points them toward a housekeeping agency—but not just any agency.
Bunny’s Moms specializes in warm, caring women who act as temporary “mothers,” providing head pats, home-cooked meals, and a whole lot of healing. To Ayato’s surprise, the first to arrive is none other than Rinko herself… now officially his new mom!
Soon, more women arrive at his door: Kiyoko, the dependable childhood friend; Kana, the confident head of the agency; and Tsumugi, a sweet, flustered newlywed still learning the ropes. Each brings her own brand of motherly affection into Ayato’s once-quiet home.
This summer, a new kind of household begins to take root... one full of comfort, surprises, and more than a little heart.
CHARACTERS

Rinko Ninomiya
Tou Ariga
Literally the mom next door, Rinko lives in the apartment next to Ayato and his dad’s. Known around the neighborhood for her warm, motherly nature, she’s something of a local celebrity mom already.
She’s known Ayato since he was little and fusses over him like he were her own. And in a way, she wishes he were...
Though she has a young son herself, he wants nothing to do with her pampering, so all that untapped motherly affection is ready to be unleashed. Thanks to Bunny’s, her longtime soft spot for Ayato is about to become a full-on smothering.

Kana Jodohama
Kaoru Momozono
CEO of the rent-a-mom agency Bunny’s Moms, although when short on staff, she doesn’t hesitate to roll up her sleeves and step in herself.
At first glance, she seems cool and a little intimidating, but don’t be fooled. She’s calm, composed, and surprisingly open-minded. She’s also competent in every area of homemaking, but her perfectionist streak means she’ll happily take notes from anyone better.
With her husband working overseas and almost never home, she’s more or less living the solo life. Maybe, just maybe, she’s looking for someone to fill the quiet...

Kiyoko Oda
Ren Haruna
The lovely wife at long-beloved local bathhouse Oda Springs Eternal. She helps out at the front desk from time to time, but most of the heavy lifting is handled by her husband and in-laws. To pitch in with the family finances and get a little break from full-time mom duty, she decides to sign up with Bunny’s.
Kiyoko and Ayato go way back—he used to greet her every morning on his way to school, and their relationship has always felt a bit like a big-sister-little-brother dynamic. Her two daughters adore Ayato too, so everything’s been smooth sailing thus far...
Still, Kiyoko’s always had a quiet longing: she wants to raise a son of her own. So when the chance to spoil Ayato comes along, she’s more than ready to play the doting mom he’s never had.

Tsumugi Kido
Musubi Aono
A newlywed whose husband was sent off on a year-long solo assignment just six months after the wedding.
To stave off her loneliness and prep for the baby they promised to make when he gets back, she joins Bunny’s for a little hands-on parenting practice.
Tsumugi’s still new to the job, and with her naturally playful, slightly childish personality, she struggles to act more like a “mom” than a big sister. But she's trying her best, even if “motherhood” isn’t as easy as she thought...

Ayato Hirose
—
A second-year at Ouba Academy, Ayato lost his mother at a young age and has been living alone with his dad ever since. To support his always-busy old man, he’s taken charge of the cooking, cleaning, and general home upkeep.
Though he puts on a capable front, Ayato secretly longs to be mothered again and finds himself drawn to the warm, idealized image of the mom next door, Rinko.
With youthful, almost girlish good looks that get him doted on by people of all ages, Ayato can’t help but feel a little self-conscious about just how adorable everyone seems to think he is...
