title: Hank: Drowning On Dry Land
description:
"Let me bring you up to speed. First of all, I’ve got your friend. Secondly, I’ve strapped your friend to a very large bomb. Thirdly, you can deactivate the bomb. Do it before time runs out and you’ll save not only him, but also yourself. Now get to it! Time’s ticking!"
Hank: Drowning On Dry Land is a time-traveling game in which you play as Hank - a Batman-esque vigilante fighting a sadistic mastermind calling himself The Unraveler.
In order to save the day and outsmart the infamous villain, Hank will have to jump in time, not once but multiple times. With each time jump, he will create another version of himself. When he reaches a point where there are many versions of Hank from many distinctive timelines running around who is to tell, which one is the real? And at the same time, who is the player taking control of the superhero?
Project Co-founded by:

title: Junkster
description: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky little construction bot, UM-13 (or Um for short), has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.

title: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
description:
Dans les années 80, Defender of the Crown a été l'un des précurseurs des jeux de stratégie cinématographique. Aujourd'hui, il est de retour dans une version remasterisée pour les plateformes modernes, avec un tout nouveau mode de jeu.

Partez à la conquête des territoires, levez des armées, prenez d'assaut les châteaux et renversez l'équilibre des pouvoirs. Retrouvez Defender of the Crown comme dans vos souvenirs, avec une touche de modernité.

Mode Rétro : la version originale sur Amiga sous sa forme la plus authentique, avec quelques améliorations de confort.

Mode Classique : le classique sur Amiga remis au goût du jour, avec une toute nouvelle identité visuelle, des mécaniques retravaillées et des systèmes plus fluides.

Mode Royaume : un tout nouveau défi proposant des cartes générées de manière procédurale, des mécaniques de dés spéciales, des aptitudes à débloquer et plusieurs niveaux de difficulté pour rendre chaque partie imprévisible.


Tout ce qui a fait le succès de l'original reste intact : les règles, le rythme, l'atmosphère. À cela viennent s'ajouter des systèmes plus épurés, un meilleur équilibrage, une interface modernisée et des améliorations de confort.

title: BLOK Demo
description:
BLOK is coming soon and can be wishlisted
here
BLOK is a first-person psychological horror game set in a Polish neighbourhood in the 1990s.

Years after fleeing the country for political reasons, you return to your old apartment block,  brought back by a strange letter from your mother. The neighborhood seems to be the same. But something is not right. It is almost too perfect. And the more you search the more cracks you find.

Explore the neighborhood, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth shaped by fear, silence, and control. Traces of life under a regime based on secrecy and repression. As you investigate, the world subtly transforms around you.

BLOK offers:
First-person atmospheric exploration in retro aesthetics that perfectly fit the tone and memories of 90s eastern european neighbourhood.
Story-driven gameplay with environmental storytelling that touches on life under a regime and historical events
Meaningful puzzles integrated into the narrative and the story
Changes in space and tone as the story and the mystery unfolds
Hauntingly familiar yet nostalgic world inspired by post-communist Poland
Customization of a "retro" look. Adjust pixelation, color precision etc. in the settings

The story doesn’t tell you everything. It lets you find it. Hidden in walls, staircases, basement and buried in layers of memories and silence.

title: Blades of Fire Demo
description:
The full version of Blades of Fire is available on GOG.com. You can purchase it here


Découvrez le début du jeu Blades of Fire dans cette démo : forgez vos premières armes, plongez dans son système de combat unique, affrontez un gigantesque troll et commencez à percer les mystères du voyage d'Aran.

Votre progression pourra être transférée vers la version complète du jeu grâce à votre fichier de sauvegarde.

Avant de commencer la démo, gardez ces quatre conseils en tête :
- Dans le monde de Blades of Fire, vous ne pourrez récupérer aucune arme. C'est à vous de forger les vôtres, à votre manière. Maîtrisez les secrets de la forge, et nul ne pourra vous égaler sur le champ de bataille.
- Vos armes s'usent au combat. Soyez attentif à leur efficacité, car elle diminue avec l'usure. Utilisez-les à bon escient, et prévoyez toujours des options de secours dans votre inventaire.
- Le combat est éprouvant. Adoptez une posture défensive pour récupérer plus rapidement. Cette technique appelée le « Souffle du défenseur » est cruciale si vous voulez survivre.
- Écoutez bien Adso ! Il vous sera d'une aide précieuse tout au long de votre périple.
Rappelez-vous : cette démo ne fait qu'effleurer tout ce que Blades of Fire a à offrir.

L'aventure complète vous fera découvrir un monde incroyablement riche !

Découvrez une nouvelle aventure d'action développée par le studio primé MercurySteam, où vous forgez vos armes et affrontez de redoutables ennemis dans un système de combat unique.

Forgez les armes de votre choix et choisissez parmi sept différentes familles d'armes.

title: The Golden Caravan Demo
description:
The Golden Caravan is coming soon and can be wishlisted
here

Welcome to The Golden Caravan, kid. A place where fortunes are made, loyalties are lost, and every hand could be your last. Set in a smoky noir-inspired 1930s underworld, this joint ain’t run by mobsters... birds with sharp suits and cold hearts are the ones calling the shots.

This is just a small sample of what the full version of The Golden Caravan will offer in its full version.
2 distinct Casino Floors.
30 Trinkets with unique effects
3 Progression shops
10 weapons to use
Unlimited playtime!!

You walk the streets as Charlie Colombo, a slick pigeon with more guts than sense. When his grandfather Carlo Colombo, a respected locksmith, is kidnapped and dragged into the infamous Golden Caravan Casino, Charlie has no other choice but to step back into the world of rigged games, feathered crime lords, and debts paid in blood.


SATISFYING POKER-BASED COMBAT
'Round these parts, battles are fought at the Poker Table!
Play Poker Hands to deal damage, gain armor, heal up and even stun your opponents.


GAME-CHANGING TRINKETS
The Slots whisper promises... One pull, and you’re hooked.
Hit the Slot Machines scattered through the casino to earn Trinkets that offer unique effects and gameplay twists.


ENGAGING ROGUELITE PROGRESSION
Climb your way to the top, one favor at a time.
Your Allies will give you Weapons, teach you Tricks and provide you other Permanent Upgrades... at a price.


NOIR-INSPIRED 1930s ATMOSPHERE
Cigarette smoke, jazz in the background, neon lights flickering over rain-soaked streets…
The Golden Caravan it’s a place you enter chasing fortune… and leave only if luck still remembers your name.


A GAME OF PAYBACK
Every hand hides a motive... this one’s revenge.
Find whoever kidnapped your grandfather, uncover the truth behind The Golden Caravan, and maybe… just maybe… the House won't win this time.

title: Okko The Exiled
description:
Fight to join the isolated world of Kutala with the heavens and fulfill an ancient oath!
Get ready to embark on an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch, deflect and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens! After 1,000 years of concealment, Okko is ready to wield the Mighty Fang and take down Kutala’s lords one by one. Defeat powerful foes, overcome obstacles and unleash your heart as Okko fights to fulfill an ancient oath. Enjoy meticulously hand-drawn 2D animations that bring Kutala’s characters to life in retro-inspired pixel art glory!


Explore side-scrolling stages with precision platforming, link attacks to form devastating combos, send enemies flying and face down enormous bosses that require quick-thinking strategy! As capable as Okko may be, he won’t be alone in his quest. A colorful cast of allies will sell you valuable items, fill your belly and provide useful information at The Old Throne, a place of respite with its own buried secrets to uncover. Upgrade and unlock new abilities to give Okko an edge in combat, collect Deevols to unlock Underground challenge levels and more. A devilish world of discovery is at Okko’s fingertips!


Features:

Run, leap, stomp, deflect and launch enemies into the air as the nimble Okko!
Explore a world of demons in side-scrolling platformer style.
Take down demon lords in strategic real-time combat!
Upgrade abilities and meet with allies at The Old Throne, a hub area with its own buried secrets.
Find and collect Deevols to unlock special challenges.
Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and a cast of memorable characters!

title: Survival Log
description: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is a zombie-apocalypse hoarding survival sim. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

title: Photomaly
description: A PSX-style horror game where you manage a photo studio. Restock supplies, buy upgrades, photograph customers and print their order whilst encountering unexpected events.

title: Desktop Explorer (2026)
description:
Discord Server

About the Game
Your uncle has given you his old PC as living inheritance. To your surprise, it still turns on! Inside, a letter tasks you with investigating a missing person’s case along with a mysterious puzzle game named Desktop Explorer. You’ll learn that your uncle wasn’t the only one who used this computer before, and that the program inside it has a deeper role in this 90s atmospheric digital mystery.

Features
• Explore a 90’s operating system where every window hides a clue.

• Solve puzzles using classic OS tools like: file explorers, chat logs, and corrupted applications.

• Dig through abandoned software and forgotten files to uncover the truth.

• Experience a psychological horror mystery told through eerie interfaces and fragmented memories.

• Navigate immersive 3D environments rendered in retro-digital aesthetics.

• Listen to an original evocative soundtrack and nostalgic computer sounds

• Play classic pre-installed computer games

 

Photosensitivity Warning
This game contains occasional flashing lights, screen effects, and rapidly changing imagery that may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy or light sensitivities.

Desktop Explorer does not use generative AI-created content.
All artwork, writing, music, sound design, programming, and game assets have been created by our development team and through traditional creative processes.

title: COP BASTARD
description:
COP BASTARD  is a old-school classic first-person shooter inspired by action movies from the 90s
History:
Japan, Osaka, early 90s.
Detective Katasha B. has a very bad reputation as a cruel, rude and unprincipled police officer, just a bastard.
Local residents and small bandyugans try to stay away from him, because of his not the cleanest and most obvious solutions to problems. Among local boys, he is known as "Uncle Berry", due to the fact that he does not part with his beloved pistol Beretta, the only love in his life that has never let him down.
However, even such a character, who avoids any serious business, manages to get into a story that he tried to avoid all his life ...
Key features of the game:
A bunch of crazy action:
Lots of intense gunfights - make yourself be remembered in this city. Shoot, shoot, shoot...
An exciting story:
Immerse yourself in the game and until the very end it will not be clear how the amazing story of a cop from Osaka will end.
Nice graphics and sounds:
The graphics and sounds in the game are made in such a way that the player fully feels like a character and plunges into the story.

title: Fish Lab
description:
A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.
100,000 fish on screen
Hover your cursor over fish to collect on the beat. Use a variety of tools to collect as many fish as you can.

The lab gets huge
Every fish you collect earns you money. As you play the lab automatically grows.

Choose how to power your tools
Decide which tools get extra power.

Upgrade your lab and equipment
Write grants to unlock big equipment upgrades on top of the 200+ upgrades in the tech tree.

Extra Game Modes
• Sandbox

• Endless

• Zen - installable as a real Windows screensaver

title: Cozy Game Restoration
description:
Cozy Game Restoration is about the quiet satisfaction of restoring something that matters. You’ll unwrap carefully sealed packages to discover old, battered video game cartridges. They'll be covered in stickers, markers, dust, and all the accumulation of time. Each one is different, flawed in its own way, and waiting to be brought back to life.

RESTORE FORGOTTEN RETRO GAMES
Every cartridge is procedurally dirtied. Some have clean labels but cracked shells. Others are scuffed, drawn on, or covered in adhesive residue. Grime is layered. Dust, ink, discoloration, stickers, and scratches each require a different tool to remove. Surfaces stretch, smear, and lift as you work. It’s slow, tactile, and satisfying.

LOOT BOXES BUT IN A GOOD WAY
Game cartridges will arrive inside mystery parcels sealed with tape. You’ll peel them open by hand, lifting the flaps, and wrestling with sticky tape to see what’s inside. Each game has randomized conditions and visuals, with 108 distinct titles inspired by classics from the 1980s to early 2000s.

Some are common finds, but others can be much rarer. You’ll encounter regional variants of carts, sticker artwork, and even shells made of gold (or better). Every game you restore will bring you closer to completing your collection, and there’s always a chance something unexpected will show up.

COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION
As you restore games, you’ll complete collection-based quests. This might be simple stuff like “collect three puzzle games”, or “two rare platformers”, but you’ll also see more unique things which work with the game’s in-game calendar like “Have 4 sci-fi games on your game shelf on November 7”.
Each finished quest will reward you with a gift. Inside will be a decoration or cosmetic for your collection room that you can use to make it a little more personal.

BUILT FOR THE FEELING
There’s no timer and no fail state in this game, but that doesn’t mean it's a shallow experience. There’s a deep set of interwoven systems which keeps gameplay varied and interesting, all whilst respecting the quiet chill vibes of a cleaning game. 
If you’ve ever carefully peeled a sticker, dug through 2nd hand store games for a rare gem, or reminisced about your old collection, this is for you.

The game runs great on desktop, but it is being built from the ground up for Steam Deck. I’m planning on making this performant on a pretty wide range of systems.

title: MARVEl MaXimum Collection
description: The MARVEL MaXimum Collection on Steam is a curated archive of classic 1980s and 90s Marvel games developed and published by Limited Run Games. It bundles six nostalgic arcade, 8-bit, and 16-bit titles, packed with modern quality-of-life features like save states, rewind functions, and visual filters

title: CiniCross
description: CiniCross is a dark fantasy roguelite where nonogram puzzles meet dungeon crawling. Solve increasingly complex puzzles, choose your path through a branching dungeon, and bend the rules using powerful artifacts. Each room is a puzzle. Each boss, a deadly challenge.

title: ShantyTown
description:
Ce jeu s'inspire de mon amour pour les villes densément construites à travers le monde, ces endroits où chaque mur, chaque ruelle et chaque toit raconte une histoire.

Vous serez encouragé à construire en hauteur, à combler les moindres espaces vides et à trouver des moyens astucieux de placer des sources lumineuses ou des décorations pour donner vie à vos créations.

Vous incarnez un géomètre chargé de construire et de photographier 20 lieux distincts, chacun avec son ambiance et son identité propres. Que ce soit la lueur chaleureuse du Hotpot Casino, les espaces charmants et exigus du Marshlands Pipe ou la solitude du Lighthouse, chaque lieu vous offre une nouvelle perspective.

C'est à vous de décider comment agencer les éléments.

Des améliorations sont disponibles pour les structures plus importantes telles que les bâtiments et les portes, mais elles nécessitent un peu d'attention pour atteindre leur plein potentiel. En fournissant de la lumière, des équipements et des décorations, des lieux tels que les magasins, les immeubles d'habitation ou les portes peuvent évoluer vers des espaces détaillés. Une fois une amélioration terminée, de nouveaux objets et décorations sont débloqués, vous offrant encore plus de possibilités pour façonner la ville.

Lorsque vous avez terminé un emplacement, cadrez la photo, prenez-la, puis ajoutez-la à votre dossier avant de passer à votre prochaine toile vierge.


Chaque emplacement présente un ensemble unique d'objets et un espace limité pour construire. Qu'il s'agisse de food trucks, d'enseignes lumineuses ou de cheminées industrielles, les joueurs doivent tout agencer avec soin pour créer un espace dense et vivant qui semble cohérent.

Il s'agit d'un jeu décontracté de bout en bout. Il n'y a pas de mauvaises réponses ici. N'oubliez pas de personnaliser chaque emplacement, et chaque petit coin en désordre ajoute au charme.


Des décorations uniques sur chaque carte.
Découvrez l'histoire de chaque lieu au fur et à mesure que vous construisez.
Une bande-son chaleureuse et relaxante composée par l'artiste vaporwave Macroblank.
Des objectifs optionnels pour guider votre créativité.
Des paysages paisibles et atmosphériques pour vous détendre.
Des réglages de caméra avancés pour cadrer vos créations.
Des objets cachés à découvrir.
Pas de limite de temps ni de pression. Profitez de tout à votre rythme.

title: The Big Suck
description:
YOUR FIRST VICTIM IS A BLADE OF GRASS


The Big Suck is an arcade incremental where you steer a tornado, earn cash from everything you wreck, and spend it on upgrades between runs.

At first, grass is a worthy opponent. A hay bale feels ambitious. A barn is personal.

Then the camera pulls back.

EVERY WRECK PAYS. SPEND IT ON A WORSE STORM


When the wind dies you get a damage report and a payday. Spend it in the upgrade tree: a wider pull, a longer clock, a nastier chain reaction.

Then touch down again and settle up with the barn that survived.

PICK YOUR CATASTROPHE


Past a certain size you stop being weather and start choosing what kind.

  • BECOME FIRE. Spread infernos from target to target.
  • BECOME THE FLOOD. Throw bow waves down whole streets, then run current through the wet ground.
  • BECOME WINTER. Hold still, let the cold spread, then crack one frozen block and take the district with it.
  • BECOME THE VOID. Open a hole and let matter stop pretending it is permanent.

Switch between touchdowns. Once a storm is yours, it stays yours.

THE WORLD FIGHTS BACK. IT GOES BADLY


Fire crews try to contain you. Bomb squads defuse your best chain reactions. Tanks roll in, jets scramble, and eventually somebody authorizes a weapon that should not be pointed at weather.

Catch the shells in your wind. Return them. Get paid for the inconvenience.

By then the map is not a place. It is the next thing you outgrow.

EARTH IS THE FIRST PLANET


Finish Earth's campaign and take your storm to ZORB, an alien world. Crack open its ore veins and spend CORES on permanent upgrades.

THE COWS GET A FARM


It seems only fair. TORNADO FARM is a cow-farm incremental inside the game. Grow your herd and earn permanent bonuses for your tornado.

WHAT'S IN THE GAME


  • About 5–6 hours to the main campaign finale. Start with grass. Finish by tearing the planet apart.
  • 66 achievements. About 12–18 hours to get them all.
  • 23 storm forms. 363 upgrades. Build your way from a light breeze to THE BIG SUCK.

THE BIG SUCK


A TORNADO WITH A BUSINESS PLAN.

title: Leviathan: Rhino
description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

title: DERELIKT
Clean Start
description:
In Clean Start, you clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering heartfelt stories through the objects you find. Piece together each room’s narrative, discover hidden secrets, and experience the satisfaction of tidying up spaces in this cozy puzzle game set in a country whose language you don’t fully understand.

Experience satisfaction from tidying up spaces, without time pressure or stressful game overs. Sink into a highly satisfying activity and let yourself be drawn into a trance of warmth and comfort. Enjoy a relaxing puzzle experience that’s easy to pick up and offers a break from the stresses of everyday life.

While dialogues provide context, the main story of each level is told through the discovery of interesting objects. Players must piece together the story, either to satisfy their curiosity or to help the clients with more than just a dirty apartment.

Create your own cozy space in a rented apartment using items found while cleaning. Your conversations with your employers—and the gifts they give you—will vary depending on what you discover in each level.

Step into the shoes of Lena, an immigrant maid, as she tries to communicate with her clients using a limited understanding of a foreign language. Clean Start is a game inspired by real experiences, highlighting the worries and hopes of immigrant life.
 
Features:
• Relaxing, cozy and positive atmosphere.

• Satisfying gameplay with no time limits or game overs, but with multiple solutions and outcomes.

• Environmental storytelling – piece together a heartfelt and emotional story about life in a new country.

• Cute dioramas, filled with hundreds of interesting items waiting to be cleaned.

• Dozens of interactive elements to engage with.

• Your personal cozy space in a rented apartment, arranged using items found while cleaning.

• Intuitive and accessible controls.

title: Handmancers
description: Handmancers is a Rock, Paper, Scissors Roguelite deckbuilder with a first-person twist where clear tactical choices meet deck-building depth. Craft your deck, enhance your cards, equip tricky artifacts and face powerful enemies in strategic fights

title: Underkeep
description:
DESCEND. EXPLORE. SURVIVE.

Underkeep is a loving tribute to the role-playing classics of the 90s with turn-based combat and grid-based movement, bringing the best of old-school dungeon crawlers to the modern era.


Underkeep brings back the spirit of classic dungeon crawlers: grid movement, slow tension and tactical combat. At the same time it plays clean and responsive thanks to modern controls, clear visuals and thoughtful conveniences that remove the old frustrations without losing the heart.


Gather your party, venture into hand-built dungeons, speak with peculiar locals, discover hidden passages, solve ancient puzzles and face encounters where planning matters as much as courage.
FORGED PARTY

Pick four adventurers whose strengths and flaws define how you survive. Synergy is everything: a good team deepens your strategy, a bad one seals your grave.

LIVING DUNGEONS

Every corridor is handmade, every room hides intent. Expect strange rituals, lingering spirits, abandoned camps, cryptic symbols and choices that echo deeper than you expect.

TACTICAL COMBAT

Turn-based battles reward those who plan, control space and manage stamina & mana wisely. The bold are rewarded. The careless are punished.

HIDDEN SECRETS

Hidden alcoves, fake walls, optional bosses and puzzles that fit the world instead of breaking immersion.


MODERN COMFORT

Smooth controls and clear feedback preserve the flow of exploration without sacrificing tension.

PERSONAL MAP

A built-in automap with custom markers keeps track of mysteries, locked doors and places you swear you’ll return to later.



Every step is a story. Every descent a decision. Underkeep awaits.

title: Wall World Strategy
description:
The Wall is a colossal structure stretching far beyond the visible horizon, hiding traces of ancient eras and unexplained phenomena within its depths. Here, among stone, metal, and darkness, humanity has been forced to build a new life – clinging to the Wall and trying to survive in a world full of threats and mysteries.

Wall World Strategy is a colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. Build and expand your base, gather resources, take care of your people, strengthen your defenses, and send expeditions into distant regions and unexplored depths. Each new step forward brings not only opportunities for growth but also new dangers. Survival depends on your foresight, your ability to manage limited resources, and your willingness to make difficult decisions.

BUILD AND EXPAND THE COLONY
Establish a base on the surface of the Endless Wall and gradually turn a small outpost into a large, stable, and well-defended colony. Plan the placement of key structures, develop production chains, expand living areas, and build infrastructure capable of supporting both population growth and stable operations.
As your colony grows, you will need to decide how to expand, which structures to prioritize, and where to allocate resources – whether into production, housing, or defense.
WITHSTAND THE THREATS
The Wall is far from lifeless. In its shadows lurk zyrexes – dangerous creatures that will attack your colony again and again, testing its defenses, organization, and your ability to respond. Strengthen your defenses, secure vulnerable areas, and decide how much you can afford to invest in protection.
Additional pressure comes from emergency events such as accidents, disasters, and environmental hazards. They won't destroy your colony instantly, but they will disrupt its operations and trigger cascading problems.

MANAGE YOUR SOCIETY
Your colony is, above all, made up of people – living, working, hoping for the future, and depending on your decisions. Monitor their condition and take into account how they react to your choices. Overpopulation, food shortages, or supply disruptions can quickly lead to declining efficiency, crisis, and riots.
Caring for your people is a core part of the strategy. The state of your population determines the performance of the entire colony – its productivity and its ability to endure prolonged periods of danger. A strong and well-supported society recovers faster from attacks and moves forward with greater confidence.
GATHER RESOURCES AND ADVANCE
Start with basic resource extraction and gradually build a more complex economy. Explore the depths of the Wall, search for stable resource deposits, and develop the infrastructure needed to use them efficiently.
Technological progress allows you to improve core systems and unlock new possibilities. Enhance resource gathering and processing, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and strengthen your colony against external threats. Some technologies accelerate infrastructure development, others improve defense, automate key processes, or expand your ability to explore new areas of the Wall.

SEND OUT EXPEDITIONS
To explore beyond your colony, deploy robo-spiders – specialized machines designed for scouting, resource extraction, and operations in remote areas. Send them into uncharted sectors of the Wall to expand your reach, gather resources, uncover rare discoveries, and explore areas that are too dangerous or inaccessible for humans.
However, distant regions bring not only opportunities but also risks. Expeditions may encounter hostile environments, unstable terrain, unknown lifeforms, or remnants of ancient machinery whose purpose has long been forgotten. Prepare your equipment, assess the risks, and decide how far you're willing to go.
EXPLORE THE DEPTHS OF THE WALL
The Wall is more than just the surface your colony clings to. Beneath it lies an entire world filled with resources, forgotten technologies, and rare artifacts. Extract valuable materials, recover technological samples that can accelerate your development, and uncover unique objects that help you understand this world.
As you explore, you will begin to find answers – but each discovery raises new questions about the nature of the Wall and why it became humanity's last refuge.
PLAY BY YOUR OWN RULES
Develop your colony in Sandbox Mode without story constraints or time pressure. Choose from different maps and difficulty levels, tailor the conditions to your liking, and keep playing for as long as you want.
Zyrexes will still attack, but you can play at your own pace and experiment with different development and defense strategies.

title: Playrooms
description:
Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.
You don't know how long you've been working here, but you know what needs doing: over 200,000 balls are scattered everywhere, and you bring them back to their ball pits. Nobody told you why.

Your Job
Collect the balls. Bring them back. Fill the ball pits. Full ball pits unlock new abilities, and collected balls are your currency. Eventually you'll have enough for the key to the next area. The work stays the same, only the room changes. Tiles, water, endless corridors, a hallway with more doors than it should have.

Tools
The more balls you collect, the more equipment you can afford. A scoop or a flashlight. Everything you need to keep working.

Observe Working Hours
When your shift is over, the lights start to go out one by one. Then there is only one thing that matters: stay in the light! Because you don't want to find out what is waiting for you in the darkness.

Flexible Working Arrangements
No fear at all, the way it’s meant to be, or no second chances? You decide how dangerous your job gets.

title: Message From Aliens
description:
In year 2058, Earth received a large number of mysterious symbols from space. Who are they? Where are they from? And more importantly, what are they talking about?

Message From Aliens is a sci-fi puzzle game about decoding an alien language.
The entire game interface is written in mysterious symbols, and the only human language you can see in this game is your own notes.

Features: 
1. An alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 characters, and more than 20,000 characters of game text.
You don't need to translate everything if you want to reach the game's ending. And there is plenty of content and secret if you want to explore more.
2. Don't be scared by the number of characters. The alien logograms are designed to be more logical and less complex than human logograms.
3. The first chapter of this game introduces alien number system. Most of the alien texts are just equations. (Alien Carl Sagan also believes math is the universal common knowledge.)
And the last chapter includes alien poetry and alien jokes.
4. In-game alien-alien dictionary.
5. This game is inspired by the novels Stories of Your Life and Contact.
In fact, you are playing both protagonist's role, interpreting alien signals and deciphering an alien writing system.
Don't worry. Playing game will not teleport you to light-years away, or turn your understanding of time non-linear.
6. Some scientific concepts are involved, such as gravity and water electrolysis.
This game is not recommended for players under 15 years old.
7. Mini-games (in alien language)

title: Mycelarium
description:
MYCELARIUM IS A MEDITATIVE INCREMENTAL GAME
Start with a single mushroom. Spread your mycelium through the soil, discover hidden resources, and build a thriving underground network. Automate resource production, unlock strange new mushrooms, and watch your tiny organism grow into a vast, self-sustaining fungal empire. 
The forest is alive, but not hostile. Leaves fall and decay into food. Hedgehogs wander across the surface. Trees can become future sources of nutrients. There is no rush and no hard fail state, only the quiet pressure to expand, adapt, and connect.
Explore an endless procedural underground filled with food pockets, water reservoirs, hard soil, and impassable stone. Build your fungal empire one thread at a time.

FEATURES
• Grow a living underground mycelium network from a single mushroom

• Aim new growth with a slingshot-style control system

• Collect underground food pockets and connect to water reservoirs

• Improve range, width, water efficiency, node cost, budding chance, and soil penetration

• Unlock specialized mushroom mutations

• Launch wind-carried spores to create distant new growth points

• Build different mushrooms on the surface

• Parasitize trees

• Explore an endless procedural underground world

• A calm pixel-art forest

• Play at your own pace with no hard fail state

title: Lost Host
description:
Be part of the Lost Host community

About the Game

One night, a boy mysteriously disappears, leaving his favorite RC car behind. Left all alone, the little car sets out to find him. But getting out of the house is only the beginning...
A Big World for a Little Car
Explore the boy's house, drive through the city, and discover all kinds of places — from cozy corners to abandoned buildings and creepy locations. Solve puzzles, move objects, and find ways to overcome obstacles. When you're the size of a toy, the world looks completely different!

Watch Where You're Driving!
There are plenty of dangers waiting out there. Dogs, robotic vacuums, creepy toys, and other enemies might get in your way. Jump over obstacles, avoid enemies, and tackle all kinds of challenges along the way. And if you're up for it, there are even a few races to test your driving skills!

Upgrade Your Little Car
Collect stars and spend them on upgrades. Install a more powerful motor, unlock the ability to jump, and equip new gadgets to help you overcome obstacles and explore new places.

So, What Happened to the Boy?
Why did the boy disappear? And where could he have gone? The little car has a long way to go before finding the answers.

title: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
description: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

title: Potato Please
description:
Congratulations, Comrade. The nation has entrusted you with a vital responsibility: keeping the army fed. Peel the potatoes, prepare the supply, and improve your operation in service of the greater good. Work hard, work efficiently, and remember: the army is hungry.
PEEL THE POTATOES
Your job is simple: peel the potatoes and get them into the water.
Pick them up, peel them by hand, and toss them in one by one.
FINISH THE PILE
Clear the pile and find faster ways to get the job done.
What starts as manual work gradually turns into a much more efficient operation.
AUTOMATE THE PROCESS
Turn repetitive work into a system.
Collect potatoes in bulk, use machines to process them, and automate more of the job as your operation grows.

title: Ultima VIII Gold Edition
description:
On the world of Pagan, the Guardian’s forces are firmly entrenched and his control is absolute. The rules are different here from familiar Britannia, and you must discover how to defeat the ruling Elemental Titans on their own terms, while solving the mystery of their enigmatic pentagram. The time has come to bring the battle to the Guardian.
A richer, livelier story in this luxuriously detailed world - we’ve condensed the essential elements of an Ultima into a fast-paced, thrilling adventure.
Intense magic and fantasy - you invoke runes, rituals, reagents and enchantments against an array of creatures from a deceptively small doppelganger to dire trolls and demons.
A closer blend of fantasy and reality than ever before - real-world physics and game play, including real-time combat where you make all the decisions.
A wide variety of movements that complement the greater role-playing realism. Leaping, climbing, running, throwing and combat are more convincing than ever.
Alone in a strange world - without any companions, you must rely on your own strength, dexterity, intelligence and magical abilities to interact with natives who have their own lives and schedules.
Incredibly smooth and lifelike animation - 400 frames of art per character (1200 frames for the Avatar) and 10 times the character art of any previous Ultima!
A new, more natural perspective.
4-voice digital sound that lets you hear more than one sound effect at a time - hear two sword strokes plus your opponents’ cries over the murmuring of a nearby brook.

title: Scawy Game
description:
Scawy Game is an absurd first-person parody horror game about Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer who buys a cheap asset house in the middle of nowhere to write his next book.
He arrives with his daughter and dog. 
The house seems cheap, suspiciously familiar, and almost normal. 
It comes with one simple responsibility.
 
Survive 4 days and 4 nights in the house, feed the cats, unlock bizarre skills, and try to defeat the entity hiding inside.
ONE SIMPLE TASK: FEED THE CATS
The previous owner had only one request before she died: feed her three cats every day.
Find them.
 Feed them. 
 Try not to question why one of them is named CheMeowvara.
WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING
- Explore a suspiciously normal home 
- Complete strange objectives
- Squeeze an inflatable chicken to reduce panic
- Unlock bizarre skills 
- Survive 4 days and 4 nights 
- Try to defeat the entity hiding inside the house (there's always one)

HORROR, HUMOR, SARCASM, AND PARODY
We like horror. We also like dumb jokes. Scawy Game combines both: sarcasm, parody, absurd situations, and scares that do not always work the way they should. Keep an open mind.

title: Just Kukuruza
description:
That corn isn't going to shell itself.
There are over 1,000,000 ears of corn piled up on an old farm. You have a yard to organize and an unreasonable amount of corn to get through.
Start small. Fill a bucket and settle into the rhythm of shelling by hand. Sell your first sacks and put the money back into the farm. Before long, that quiet little job can become a busy operation of rattling machines, moving conveyors, workers hauling loads, and trucks waiting for their next shipment.

FROM YOUR FIRST COB TO YOUR LAST TRUCKLOAD
Just Kukuruza is a first-person work and automation simulator about clearing an enormous mountain of corn.
You can do the work yourself, hire help, or build a production line that handles more of the job for you. Carry corn in buckets, push a wheelbarrow, or use a handheld suction blower.
Every upgrade changes how you work. Every shipment helps pay for the next one. The goal stays simple: process and sell the corn, right down to the last ear.

GET YOUR HANDS DIRTY
Take a seat at the workbench and shell corn with hand tools. Move on to hand-operated shellers, then motorized machines as your operation grows.
Fill the machines, collect the grain, and carry away full sacks. Watch corn move as you pour it, and follow your loads along the conveyors.
You will get to know those first tools well. You will also know exactly why you want a better one.

BUILD YOUR OWN PRODUCTION LINE
Turn an empty yard into a working corn-processing operation.
Choose your equipment, preview its position, rotate it, and connect compatible machines and conveyors. Use straight sections, curves, junctions, feeders, and elevators to move material between different stages. Adjust the length of straight belts to suit your layout.
Bring corn from the pile to the shellers, carry the grain to automatic bagging machines, and send filled sacks towards the waiting trucks.
Start with one simple line. Expand into several. Move equipment and reorganize the farm as your plans get bigger.

HIRE A FEW EXTRA HANDS
You do not have to carry every load yourself.
Hire workers and assign them jobs around the farm. Put them to work transporting corn, supplying shellers and conveyors, operating supported equipment, or collecting filled sacks.
Workers can handle buckets, wheelbarrows, and handheld suction blowers.
Choose where people work and what equipment they use. More workers can keep a growing operation supplied. Find the balance between extra hands and better machinery.
TAKE THE CONTROLS
Sometimes the best way to understand a job is to do it yourself.
Use the handheld suction blower to collect corn and supply compatible containers, machines, or conveyors. Push a wheelbarrow where it is needed.
Walk through the operation in first person and see how everything fits together—from the corn entering a machine to the sacks leaving on a truck.
KEEP THE LOADS MOVING
A productive farm needs more than a fast sheller.
Machines need a steady supply of corn. Grain needs somewhere to go. Full sacks need collecting. Connect the stages, assign your workers, and give your equipment room to work.
Load sacks onto trucks and send shipments off for sale. Reinvest the earnings in more equipment, more workers, or another production line.
Try different approaches: stay hands-on, build around a hardworking crew, or invest in a larger automated setup.
WATCH THE MOUNTAIN SHRINK
At first, your work barely seems to make a dent. Then the buckets become wheelbarrow loads. The wheelbarrows are joined by conveyors. Another machine arrives. Another truck leaves.
The pile that once towered over the yard starts to look manageable.
There is something satisfying about standing back and seeing what you have built—and knowing that every sack came from the mountain in front of you.
FEATURES
• A mountain of over a million ears of corn to process and sell

• First-person manual work, equipment operation, and farm building

• Progression from hand tools to hand-operated shellers and motorized machinery

• Buckets, wheelbarrows, and handheld suction blowers

• Modular conveyors, feeders, grain elevators, automatic baggers, and sack-handling equipment

• Equipment placement with previews, rotation, compatible connection snapping, and adjustable straight conveyor lengths

• Hireable workers with selectable jobs, equipment, and destinations

• Visible corn and material moving through your operation

• Truck loading and shipments that fund further expansion

• Flexible layouts and different approaches to growing your business

• A weathered farm to turn into your own corn-processing operation

title: After the Wane
description:
After the Wane DEMO is available
here.


The new interactive graphic novel by the creators of Along the Edge and Across the Grooves.

Lena is a starry-eyed young dancer with big dreams, but as soon as she sets foot in the capital, she finds herself at the nexus of a lifelong quarrel between Fernand, the elusive director of a community center, and Deborah, who's leading the troupe of a strange and exclusive theatre. Does it have anything to do with her mother, a dancer too, who abandoned her when she was a child?
Torn between her past and her future, Lena will need to rediscover her own nature and forge her path forward as increasingly strange events unfold around her… but the strangest of all might be the permanent commentary of a voice that she seems to be the only one to hear.


Choose your destiny: align with an elitist dance company, mingle with everyone and help young dancers in the local community center, or stay independent while cultivating your interest in the occult.
Dance animations: experience several dance scenes throughout the story, all animated by hand in rotoscoping.
A hand-crafted adventure: With each playthrough, discover a novel-sized adventure and a slice of the hundreds of hand-drawn images created for the game.
Immersive and finely crafted soundtrack: The music, specially composed and recorded for the game, adapts and shifts according to your choices and the mood of each scene.
High replayability: Discover the outcome of your decisions through multiple story paths and endings.

title: Abashed
description:
Abashed Demo is available here.





Abashed is a 2.5D narrative-driven side-scrolling game that lets you explore the life of Issac, a man living with psychosis. One day, waking up all alone, he sets out to find the truth behind his missing partner. On the way he finds himself needing to confront his deepest fears and the darkest secrets. Join Issac in this story of love, loss, fear, and acceptance. Reality is not what it seems.



Consume medication to alter reality that changes the environment around you for a limited period. Use this to your advantage to unlock hidden areas, find clues, and solve puzzles.




Experience unique interconnected puzzles that let you take advantage of your power to find interesting solutions. Manipulate your surroundings and unlock hidden truths as you journey deeper into the unknown.

A psychological adventure set in the mind of Issac, where the line between the real and the surreal blurs.
Puzzles that involve altering reality, manipulating the environment, collecting and using items you find.
Encounter interesting characters, each with their own traits.
Uncover a narrative rich with emotional depth, exploring themes of mental health.
Immerse yourself in a unique hand-made art style and hauntingly beautiful environments.

title: alda
description:
alda is a long-form visual novel set in the fictional nation of Makris, portraying changes in people and society through the everyday life of a girl named Alda.Conversations with friends, time spent with family, and encounters with people through her work.
These small moments gradually become connected to incidents surrounding art, conflicts of ideology, and larger forces that shake the nation.What do people living through a turning point in history see? What do they think, and how do they change?
This is a story that explores everyday life and society as one continuous whole.This is a linear visual novel with no choices or branching paths.SynopsisTwo and a half years have passed since the reforms.
The anger of suffering citizens seems to be surfacing in many places.
Many paintings have been stolen.
Famous structures have been destroyed.Changes have also begun to take place around Alda.
Diverse ideologies seem to be dividing people.
The changing world is casting her friends in a different light.Alda now finds herself in the midst of transformation.

title: Ultima III: Exodus (2026)
description:
Upon escaping the crumbling ruins of Shadowguard, the black fortress of Minax, you lay your weary body on the now-sacred ground. As you rest, you remember your first encounter with the evil wizard of Mondain, whom you later tracked down and destroyed. The existence of his apprentice, Minax, was soon revealed and the crusade was begun again. Younger and more cunning than her mentor, she has been much more difficult to vanquish. But now your sense of accomplishment is touched by a chilling fear. Have all vestiges of evil been removed? Somehow, you sense that your treacherous foes have not been eliminated. Without further feats of skill, daring, and perseverance, all of your past accomplishments may be lost. You stand up, prepare your armour, and walk to the dimension door. Stepping in, the hunt resumes.
An epic fantasy role-playing experience featuring:
Up to 20 character roster
A 1 to 4 character party
Individual player movement
16 long and short range weapons
8 armour types
Magic weapons, armour and items
32 magic spells
11 character classes, 5 races
New astrological influences
New combat mode
New ship to ship or shore combat
Full color visuals throughout
New advanced dungeon graphics
New animated outdoor graphics
Sound on/off toggle
New navigational strategies
Adventure style verb entry

title: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
description:
Stamp decisions. Accidentally destroy your own empire. Repeat.

In Stamperor!, you rule as a jester making fast decisions that shape the fate of your empire. Do everything you can to prevent unexpected events from destroying your empire and leading you to defeat.

Each cycle, citizens arrive with requests, but it’s not just about saying “yes” or “no”. You use stamps with unique effects to alter your choices, create unexpected consequences, and deal with situations that spiral out of control.
Build and keep your empire standing

Expand your empire and manage Money, Food, Happiness, Security, and Population. Every structure shifts the balance of your empire and can either help or accelerate collapse. Proposals are unpredictable, and you will need to think strategically to handle each problem that appears in your realm.
Decisions that become stories

Engage in evolving storylines throughout the run, meet charismatic characters with their own interests, and face decisions that can change everything. Each character has a different personality and story, and may offer good proposals or threaten you in the most absurd ways possible
Expect the unexpected

Unpredictable events can turn your run upside down at any moment.
One mistake can trigger a chain reaction. A good decision might not be so good after all. Act impulsively, be wise, be a tyrant, be a fool, choose your way of ruling!

But don’t forget that your people need you!
Survive the chaos or be consumed by it.
A decision-driven city builder where every choice matters and can either end everything or lead you to become a glorified emperor.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Enhanced Classics Ultimate Bundle
The Adventures of Tango Rio
description:
Get ready for a hand-drawn graphic adventure full of humor and investigation. A classic point-and-click experience packed with laughs, mysteries, and wildly quirky characters!

Story
Tango Rio hasn’t seen his father in two years—not since he left with his uncle on “a journey that would change the world.” Or so he claimed. Then, silence.
The only clue: the name of a Polynesian archipelago... and the feeling that this time, the escape is different.
What awaits him? Tropical legends, strange rituals, time travel, dark prophecies, and a bunch of totally crazy characters.


Caught between wild puzzles and even wilder situations, Tango is about to dive into an adventure way beyond anything he ever expected.

Features
A 2D point-and-click adventure inspired by the great classics of the '90s, like Monkey Island, Day of the Tentacle, and Sam & Max: Hit the Road.
A story full of humor and unexpected twists.
An exotic setting in a mysterious archipelago.
Over 50 fully illustrated and hand-colored locations.
Clever puzzles and hilarious conversations with a wide cast of characters.

title: Princessfall
description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

20 hour dark fantasy JRPG built in RPG Maker
Lush backgrounds and hand-drawn event CGs
Expressive pixel art and detailed character sprites
A brutal, dog-eat-dog world of betrayal and survival
Fully voiced by veteran Japanese voice actors

STORY

A beautiful, blonde-haired debutante, born into privilege as the daughter of a noble house, but whose fortunes take a turn for the worse after her father’s untimely death...
Betrayed by her servants, stripped of her wealth, and saddled with crushing debt, she stands at the edge of ruin. Only the quick action of her one-armed butler, J, has spared her from her enemies’ grasp.
J remains by her side, guiding her through their new life together—and entrusting her with a pair of enchanted hand cannons known as Drive.
Armed with Drive and a renewed determination, Alice rises once more to defy her fate!
Will she reclaim her pride as a noble?
Or tumble headlong into darkness?
This fallen princess must now choose her path forward.
CHARACTERS
Alice Dietrich
Yuzunagi
Once the beloved young princess of House Dietrich, a proud noble family brought low after her father’s sudden death. With no home and a mountain of inherited debt, Alice was abandoned by over a hundred servants, save for one: her one-armed butler, J.
She now lives in her rented home downtown, taking on odd quests alongside J to chip away at her family’s obligations. Her dream is to cast off her burden and reclaim the noble life she once knew.

Hilda Geisler
Ao Inukai
Charismatic, cunning, and cruel, Hilda is the leader of Eden, a powerful religious order that stretches deep into the halls of government.
Thanks to her stunning beauty and political savvy, she rose from slum-born obscurity to become the king’s own confidante. In all but name, she now rules the nation—but beneath her holy title lies a ruthless heart, one that erupts in fury whenever the world denies her.

J
—
A taciturn man of strength and mystery, J is Alice’s one-armed butler and her only remaining servant after her family’s fall. Once a soldier, he lost his dominant hand saving a village woman from raiders, and later wandered the land before finding purpose again at House Dietrich.
Though he seldom speaks of the past, his skills in combat and command remain undeniable. Today, he continues to stand at Alice’s side not just as her caretaker, but as a quiet mentor in a world that’s seemingly turned against her.

title: Monkeys!¡
description:
A wacky high-tempo visual novel from the creative team behind Marco and the Galaxy Dragon and The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart!
FEATURES
Single-ending visual novel with 2+ hours of story
Full Japanese voice acting
STORY
Saruyoshi, the world’s greatest delinquent, is stomping his way to a prestigious girls’ school under the alias—“Julia.”
WHY, SARUYOSHI?! OH, WHY WOULD YOU DO THIS?!?!
To save the unprestigious boys’ school he attends!
To preserve the place where he has made friends and memories, Saruyoshi must convince Garasunomiya Girls’ School to go co-ed!
With the help of the bored and wealthy Karasu Tsukishima, he bravely attends Garasunomiya in order to improve the girls’ image of guys!
In his time at Garasunomiya, will Saruyoshi FINALLY figure out girls?!
In their time with Saruyoshi, will the girls of Garasunomiya finally find some measure of redeeming value in guys?!
As Saruyoshi sets his himbo brain to work solving Garasunomiya’s problems, the girls find their hearts growing fonder and fonder!
As Saruyoshi begins to act more like a lady, his friends back home just get more and more confused?!
Guys and girls, living together—a romanti-slapstick comedy ensues!

title: Ultima VI: The False Prophet (2026)
description:
Journey once again to Britannia, land of magic and adventure.
Uncover the mystery of the Gargoyles in this exciting sixth episode of the award-winning Ultima saga.
Fantastic Graphics & Sound Technology!
Stunning full color graphics and vivid animations
Captivating original musical scores
Cinematic Storytelling at its Best!
A classically written Ultima saga of fantasy & myth
Illustrated by leading graphic artists & animators
Simulation of a Living Fantasy World!
Thousands of colorful places & characters to discover
Hundreds of fascinating conversations and puzzles
A fully interactive world where everything has a purpose - bells ring, clocks tell time, cannons fire.
If you can touch it, you can use it!
Hours of Non-Stop Entertainment!
Immediately begin playing and enjoying
Longterm play value; you may never see it all!

title: Ultima II: The Revenge of the Enchantress (2026)
description:
The realm of adventure knows no barrier…
Not the confines of the ocean…
Nor the steepest of mountains…
It spans the vastness of space…
And the infinity of time.
A map of the realm, and the responsibility that goes with it is now yours. Welcome to the realm of adventure. Welcome to the realm of Lord British.
Only in the arena of Ultima II can you -
Seize ships
Hijack airplanes
Travel throughout the solar system
Clash with innocent bystanders
Be pursued by KGB agents
Get accosted in dark alleys
Battle pirates on the open sea
Be seduced in a bar
Dine at your favorite restaurant
Meet prominent people within the computer industry
Cast magical spells at evil creatures
Visit the Castle of Lord British
Explore deep dark deadly dungeons
Burglarize merchants
Slay vicious creatures
Charge through impenetrable forces
and
Grow to wield the most powerful magic known to man

title: DriveGear
description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.Assemble your DriveGearEvery gear is built from four parts: Core, Chassis, Axle, and Bearing. Change the way you accelerate, collide, defend, and deploy special abilities by rebuilding between encounters and crown runs. Build for attack, defense, or stamina, or find that killer combination of parts across three specialized part lines.Control Every ClashDash attack an open opponent, guard through pressure, and utilize build dependent special moves and abilities.  Find the right timing and openings to defeat difficult opponents or finish in style.Route Under PressureScout branching paths across each district. Contracts, vendors, events, characters and fights all compete for limited time. A risky detour can secure a badge, strengthen a relationship, or leave you scrambling to reach the qualifier.Customize Your GearReshape your gear as you move across the districts. Buy parts, upgrades, and badges at vendors.  Complete contracts to earn credits for vital new parts.  Every encounter is an opportunity to push your build even further.Claim the CrownEvery district brings it's own local flair, changing the opposition and the arena around you. Route through the new environments, adapt to the rivals, and make them remember your name.

title: Ultima V: Warriors of Destiny (2026)
description:
Enter the realm of Britannia: a world rich in history, adventure, and intrigue. Lord British, the benevolent ruler of Britannia, has been lost on an expedition to explore the vast reaches of a newly discovered underworld. Panic erupts in Britannia when the sole survivor of the expedition returns with dread tales of their fate.
To restore peace, the trusted but ambitious subject, Blackthorn seizes control of Britannia. His fanatical devotion to order ultimately transforms him into a self-righteous tyrant. Now, Britannia’s destiny depends on your ability to discover the fate of Lord British and unseat the merciless Blackthorn.
Highlights of Ultima V
Powerful new combat system
Watch your axes fly and your arrows soar, with detailed animated graphics.
Weave spells to conjure daemons, call forth rushing winds of flame, or become invisible to the enemy.
Employ more sophisticated combat strategies as your experience - and the challenge - increases.
Unprecedented variety and detail
Over twice the graphic detail, animation, and sound effects of earlier games, with murmuring fountains, ticking clocks and lighthouses that cut swaths of light through the night.
Over 30 multi-level villages, towns, castles and keeps to explore, some as many as five levels.
A vast new underworld, equal in size to Britannia and populated by a host of shadowy creatures never known before.
Realistic, Living World
Townsfolk and villagers go about their daily activities of working, eating and sleeping according to their own individual schedules.
The sun and twin moons rise and set while within the fortified towns and castles drawbridges raise and portcullises drop to protect the inhabitants at night.
Carry on sophisticated, life-like conversations, buy, sell or trade with hundreds of people throughout the Realm.

title: Ultima I: The First Age of Darkness (2026)
description:
It is a dark time. For many years, the Lands of Britannia prospered and flourished under the benevolent rule of Lord British. Unbeknownst to the inhabitants of Britannia, the evil wizard Mondain was slowly strengthening his magical powers and increasing his hordes of foul denizens - patiently awaiting the proper time to seize the lands. Through subtle exertions of his magical power, Mondain was able to stir dissent among the Lords of the land and render them ineffective by factional wars. Then, he did release his minions upon Britannia and crush the people beneath his evil will. And thus the First Era of the Dark Ages came upon the Lands of Britannia.
The original Ultima I was a pioneering product that established new standards in fantasy role-playing games and started what has become the best-selling saga in the history of computer gaming. Now, Origin Systems brings you the new Ultima I, a significant enhancement to the original, completely rewritten in assembly language and employing state of the art graphics.
Journey back to the First Era of the Dark Ages and embark on the original quest of the Ultima chronicles.

title: Cash is King! Business Simulator
description:
Welcome to Miami Beach. Sun, sand, and money are in the air. You start with empty pockets and work your way up in this laid-back first-person simulation. Collect cash, improve your reputation, and enjoy fun, slightly chaotic gameplay with hustles and amusing minigames. In the end, only one thing matters: Cash is King and you want the crown.

Build your own street empire
You buy and place vending machines, sell lemonade on the beach, and invest your earnings to steadily expand your own little empire.


Casual gameplay with a feel-good vibe
With hard work, a bit of luck, and a pinch of chaos, you fill your cash register, level up your business, and enjoy that good feeling when your balance grows faster than your sunburn.


Improve your reputation & keep the neighborhood clean
Your rise depends on your reputation. Keep the neighborhood clean, remove graffiti, and help people stay cool under the sun. The more popular you become, the more opportunities open up for you.



Fun minigames & charming chaos
Water gun, broom, or newspaper stand: every minigame brings variety, cash, or popularity, plus that wonderful “Just one quick thing …” effect that keeps you playing longer than you planned.


Unique characters & quirky jobs
Colorful personalities like Siggi Sunshine, Rico Cartón, Selma Slots, and Lenny accompany you on your journey and bring you jobs, tips, and new opportunities in the streets of the Sunshine State.


Furnish your apartment
Earn enough cash for your own apartment, shop for furniture at Sofa King, and make your home just the way you like it.


Your wealth
Store your earnings safely in the safe, plan new investments, and keep an eye on every dollar as you rise from a small-time beach hustler to a local mini mogul.


Now go restock the newspapers, grab your broom and water gun, head out into the streets, leave your mark on this city, and never forget: Cash is King.

title: Guild of the Tower
description: Build a guild. Raise heroes. Send them into a tower nobody remembers being built, where every fight is fought by tactics you programmed yourself (Gambit System).46 backgrounds · 100 traits · 6 weapon families · 3 schools of magic · 15-level skill trees · permadeathGuild of the Tower is a party-based RPG about building a guild from the ground up, not just assembling a party. Recruit heroes, manage their wellbeing, craft their gear, and send them climbing into a tower that has no known top, no known builder, and no known reason to exist.Recruit from a roster of dozens of heroes, each with their own background, personality, and traits. Assign them to the forge, the alchemy lab, the training grounds, or the front line. Manage mood, fatigue, and injury, because a guild that burns out its heroes doesn't survive long.Combat is ATB and fully automated through the Gambit system. Set conditional rules for each hero: heal an ally below half HP, target the enemy with the lowest resistance, attack the back line first. Then watch your strategy play out on its own. Master six weapon families, each with a deep skill tree of actives, passives, and signature techniques.Nobody knows how tall the tower is. Nobody knows what's waiting past the floors that have already been mapped. What we do know: heroes go up, and not all of them come back down. Permadeath is real. The ones who fall stay fallen, remembered only in the guild's cemetery. Whatever answers are up there, you'll have to send someone to go find them.Craft and refine equipment at the Forge and Alchemy Lab. Dispatch heroes to gather resources across the region. Build relationships between your heroes, bonds that grow, or break, over time. Upgrade a dozen guild buildings, from the Dormitory to the Tavern, and watch a handful of hopefuls grow into a legend.

title: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
description:
Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
For a few hundred years, a dragon collected and never once tidied up. Now the gold has swallowed the shelves, the furniture and most of the floor and everything the dragon actually treasures is buried somewhere inside it. You have a bag. You have time. Get sorting. 

Sweep up the hoard
Aim your bag and pull coins straight off the pile one at a time at first, then in fat, greedy handfuls. Pour them into the chests around the lair; when one fills up, it slams shut, and that gold is yours to spend.

Get scarily good at it
A deeper bag. Faster hands. More coins per grab. Nothing changes the job everything changes how it feels. By the end, you'll clear in seconds what used to take minutes.

Find what the gold buried
Books, relics, keepsakes, oddities the hoard has been swallowing them for centuries. Spot something glinting through the coins, dig it free, carry it to the shelves, and set it down exactly where it belongs. Complete a collection, and the lair opens up a little more.

Pet the cats
The cats were here long before you, and they'll be here long after. Every single one can be petted. The game keeps count.

Take your time
No timers, no fail states, nobody looking over your shoulder. The pile isn't going anywhere, and your progress saves itself.

In short
• Tons of coins, and every one of them is yours to move

title: Project Afterfall
description:
A dark turn-based strategy-survival RPG blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore.

Project Afterfall is a spin-off set in the universe of Thea: The Awakening and Thea 2: The Shattering, a thousand years later in a very different, urban age.

Customise your characters’ gender, class, and race, and recruit NPC allies to explore the wastelands of Thea, rebuild your colony, and engage in tactical card-based combat. Experience branching narratives and character progression, where every choice shapes your survival and the fate of humanity in this story-rich roguelite adventure.


Survive and Explore a Story-Rich Post-Apocalyptic World. Uncover the secrets of Thea through rich storytelling, engaging quests, and diverse points of interest. Scavenge vital resources and face environmental challenges as you navigate a retro-futuristic wasteland shaped by Slavic folklore and mystical ruins.


Develop Your Hero and Party. Lead as your main hero while assembling a diverse party of NPC allies, each with unique abilities and personalities. Build and customise your team through deck-building mechanics and character progression, tailoring strategies to overcome the wasteland’s many threats.


Overcome Tactical Challenges. Use your card deck to navigate the perils of a shattered world, resolving both combat and non-combat encounters. Battle monstrous foes in tense, turn-based skirmishes or strike dark bargains with cunning Slavic demons. The tactical use of your deck is essential to outwit enemies!


Rebuild and Manage Your Colony. Ensure the survival of your base by recruiting new NPCs for your party, expanding your settlement, and navigating the politics of the town council. Balance growth with survival as you work to revive civilisation in the ruins of humanity.



Custom Hero Creation: Personalise your hero's appearance, choose their class, gender, and tailor their abilities to suit your playstyle.
Branching Story: Every choice changes the story and shapes your future.
Rebuild & Manage: Rebuild your colony and manage resources in a crumbling world.
Survive: Stand against the cruelty of the wastelands and enemies out to get you!
Explore & Gather: Scavenge the land for rare resources and hidden secrets.
Card-Based Combat: Build your deck and fight with tactical, card-driven battles.
Craft & Customise: Craft gear, items, and of course some yummy Slavic foods!
Co-op Mode: Team up with a friend for two-player chaos!

title: Kokuhaku Confessional
description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

Short and sweet(?) doujin VN with 2.5+ hours till credits
Multiple choices, a “true” heroine, and good and bad endings
Star-studded cast of professional voice talent

STORY
Work up the courage to ask out your longtime library crush, Shiori Yomoda—if you can survive the chaos.
Just as you’re ready to shoot your shot, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: “Kokuhaku Confessional.” You’re the prized pig in this flirt-fueled battlefield, and they’re determined to knock you off course with teasing, temptation, and nonstop distractions!
Can you resist their brazen charms and stay true to Shiori? Or will you fall for one of their traps along the way?
Survive to the end without giving in—and maybe, just maybe, you’ll win Shiori’s heart.

...“Kokuhaku Confessional”?
It’s a new campus contest where girls “confess” their feelings to you—the first girl to score a yes wins the game! Is this a battle for love... or just a diversion for the bored and beautiful?

CHARACTERS
Maika Kirishima
Kanoko
Known for her striking looks and steady stream of admirers. Beneath her beauty, her sharp tongue and mean-girl reputation often leave others second-guessing. Addicted to drama, it was Maika who came up with “Kokuhaku Confessional,” if only to keep herself entertained.
In the past, you completely misread her signals and asked her out, only to be savagely rejected.

Rin Kuraishi
Haruru Akiyama
Your classmate and Maika’s best friend, Rin stands out with her refined, calm demeanor, drawing attention from boys in a way that neatly contrasts with Maika’s boldness. However, behind her good-girl facade lies a shocking secret.
Indifferent to playing “Kokuhaku Confessional” at first, she becomes intrigued after seeing Maika experience rejection firsthand.

Aoi Shimasaki
Ryo Suzuki
The third member of Maika’s posse, Aoi has known you for years. However, her towering stature and assertive personality make her intimidating to be around, so you’ve been keeping your distance.
Under her tough exterior, Aoi hides a deep, unspoken affection for you—feelings so strong that she hasn’t fully realized them yet.

Shiori Yomoda
Kasumi Yuki
A senior at your campus’s library club, Shiori is shy and introverted but shares many of your otaku special interests, sparking frequent conversations between you two.
She’s been a surprising source of comfort and encouragement after Maika shot you down, and you’ve been crushing on her in secret ever since.

title: 日本四季百景
description:
Japan Scenic Puzzle is a single-player puzzle journey through Okayama, Tottori, Shimane, Yamaguchi, and Hiroshima. Meet local guides and explore the scenery and culture of Japan's Chugoku region.
Find differences between pictures, piece together jigsaw puzzles, and answer quizzes about the places you visit. Each prefecture offers three games, followed by a final challenge connecting the region.
Take your time and use hints as you explore. Text is available in Japanese, regional dialects, and English. Progress is saved locally on your computer and can be resumed later. Steam Cloud syncing between devices is not supported.
The free demo includes the first chapter in Okayama. The full game includes all five prefectures and the final challenge.

title: Ultima Underworld 1
description:
You are the Avatar, noblest of heroes. In your day, you have beheld many wonders and proved yourself master of many dungeons. But nothing in your experience prepared you for this - the terror-filled passages of Britannia’s underworld.
Many years have passed since your last visit to Britannia. Little did you expect that, when you returned, you would be accused of kidnapping Baron Almric’s daughter, Arial - and then be thrown into the Great Stygian Abyss, without so much as a chance to prove your innocence.
Only by surviving the dangers of the Abyss and finding the villain who abducted Arial can you restore your good name. But dark hints garnered from all corners of the Abyss reveal that this was no simple kidnapping. The fate of Britannia hangs in the balance as you battle the horrors that lurk at the heart of the Great Stygian Abyss.
A True 3-D Environment!
Move smoothly and continuously through the first virtual reality dungeon. The first-person perspective of The Stygian Abyss puts you right in the thick of the action. Look down on objects at your feet, or up to see creatures hovering overhead. Every wall, precipice, object and character in The Stygian Abyss has been
painstakingly modeled in 3-D space. You’ll feel like you’re actually in the dungeon!
Unparalleled Dungeon Excitement!
Explore nearly 25 miles of winding passages, gaping chasms and frigid underground rivers. This multi-level dungeon is full of puzzling traps and fearsome monsters. A sophisticated conversation system allows you to talk with dozens of characters who may assist or hinder you in your quest. You’ll do more than kill monsters - The Stygian Abyss will challenge your virtues and your wits, as well as your fighting prowess.
Thrilling Combat & Magic!
Try a quick, relatively weak attack or take the time to put greater power behind your blow. See your weapon lash out and watch your foe stagger and fall. Each magic spell has a dramatic visual effect.
Automapping!
A sophisticated auto-map feature keeps track of your location. You can even write your own comments right on the map so you’ll always remember where each important character or landmark is found.
State of the Art Sound & Graphics!
A full, orchestral score and lush, 256-color VGA graphics complete Origin’s latest multimedia experience. No words, no still images, can prepare you for Ultima Underworld: The Stygian Abyss!

title: Space Station Designer
description:
Space Station Designer is a construction and management game where you become the CEO of a private aerospace company, in charge of creating and operating a thriving network of orbital outposts.

Begin with a single core module in Low Earth orbit and gradually extend your operations into higher Earth and Lunar orbits. Design self-sustaining stations, manage astronauts and logistics, unlock advanced technologies, and help shape humanity’s space economy.

Your ultimate ambition? Construct and operate a Lunar Space Elevator Megaproject.



Space Station Designer features three game modes:

Campaign Mode: Learn the systems through guided objectives, while developing your company through contracts, expansion, and long-term planning.
Sandbox Mode: Skip the onboarding phase and jump directly into an open-ended management experience with contracts available from the start.
Free Builder Mode: Experiment freely with every unlocked module and create your dream station designs without budgets or operational limits.


Every station is fully modular and assembled piece by piece.
Build using 150 unique modules
Reconfigure and optimize stations as your needs evolve
Balance life support, power generation, logistics, crew wellbeing, and profitability
Create specialized orbital infrastructure across multiple locations
From compact orbital outposts to sprawling industrial hubs, every design decision influences operational efficiency and long-term growth.


Success in orbit requires more than just engineering.

As the CEO of a private space company, you'll perform a wide range of activities including recruiting and managing astronauts, building and installing modules, providing commercial services, manufacturing goods, commercializing industrial R&D technologies, accommodating space tourists, leasing modules, and a lot more.

Whether you specialize in manufacturing, commercial services, or space tourism – or pursue a diversified strategy – your company’s direction is entirely yours to define.


Developed by the creators of Buzz Aldrin’s Space Program Manager and inspired by NASA concepts and decades of space exploration literature, Space Station Designer presents a grounded and optimistic vision of humanity’s future in space.

If you enjoy city builders, management games, and space exploration, Space Station Designer offers a deep and interconnected simulation of life, logistics, and industry in orbit.


Design, build, and manage a network of orbital stations across Earth orbit and beyond.
Fully modular stations using 150 unique modules
Choose your playstyle: Campaign, Sandbox, or Free Builder mode.
Recruit and manage astronauts to keep stations operational and productive
Coordinate cargo and crew transportation across your orbital network
Research and unlock advanced technologies to expand operational capabilities
Manufacture commercial goods and establish profitable industrial operations
Provide commercial services, lease infrastructure, and support space tourism
Adapt station layouts over time by redesigning and optimizing orbital networks
Work toward the ultimate megaproject: a Lunar Space Elevator
Modding support included, with tools and documentation for creating custom modules, spacecraft, and astronauts
