title: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
description:
STORY
In a faraway, skyborne land...

Perched high above the surface realms lies the lovely floating continent of Jupiterno. Princess Lucia, hailed as a "True Wizard," rules in the king’s stead.

A True Wizard’s power far surpasses that of ordinary wizards. If the average wizard is an ant, a True Wizard is the queen ant—possessing innate magic that operates on an entirely different scale.

Princess Lucia, a rare prodigy said to appear only once among billions, wields an almost divine might. Yet when her heart grows dark, she imposes tyranny across the land, slaughtering anyone who dares defy her.

Amid this reign of terror, Luna—celebrated as one of the most brilliant wizards in all of Jupiterno—finally decides to confront Lucia. Encouraged by her allies, Luna takes a stand against the dreaded True Wizard.

To bring down Princess Lucia and her allied nations, Luna and her companions form a resistance, vowing to challenge the royal capital head-on!

FEATURES
A JRPG from veteran doujin creators
Turn-based combat
An expansive world
10+ hours of story

CHARACTERS
Luna
Rima Nemurine
A top-tier wizard in Jupiterno, Luna was poised to graduate head of her class at the elite Valentina Magic Academy before unforeseen circumstances forced her to leave. Recruited by Becky, an axe-wielding housewife from the same village, she joins the resistance to take down Princess Lucia—a tyrant who recognizes Luna's exceptional abilities. Alongside her revolutionary efforts, Luna harbors a deep affection for Noah, her childhood friend.

Lucia
Miki Honda
Known as the “Black Witch,” Princess Lucia of Jupiterno reigns as a formidable "True Wizard." Cold and merciless, she exterminates anyone who resists her rule. Arrogance defines her every action, and her chilling smile never fades.

Becky
Rio Fujimura
A bold and headstrong axe-wielding housewife from Sheena Village, Becky never hesitates to leap into action—even in the face of Princess Lucia. She deeply trusts her ally, Luna. Meanwhile, her new marriage is strained by her husband's gambling habit.

Lede
Nodoka Nishiura
A mysterious traveler passing through Sheena Village with a personal retinue. Known for her playful tone that turns grave in earnest moments, she is on a relentless search for an enigmatic figure known as “Regnas Grahard.”

title: ONE FENIX DOWN
description:
ONE FENIX DOWN is a story-driven RPG and a passion project spanning nearly a decade. Inspired by the SNES-era classics, it strives to blend the perfect balance of story-pacing, combat design, and timeless characters that defined a generation of gaming.


40 Hours of Adventure: Travel across continents, kingdoms, and realms beyond in a far-reaching, character-driven journey.
Traditional Turn‑Based Combat: A tried‑and‑true system enhanced with modern mechanics and three difficulty settings designed to welcome genre newcomers and challenge veterans.
A Large, Evolving Cast: Meet a large cast of characters, each with their own motives, objectives, and ambitions.
14 Playable Party Members: A rotating cast of characters help to keep the story and party composition fresh, while encouraging new tactics and strategies.
Powerful Abilities & Excedo Skills: Wield elemental magic, martial arts, traps, monster abilities, and character-specific Excedo skills unleashed when each character’s Excedo meter fills.
Hundreds of Items & Equipment: Hundreds of unique items and equipment waiting to be discovered, many requiring an adventurous spirit to obtain.
Nostalgic SNES-Era Audio: A retro-inspired soundtrack featuring guest vocalist Emi Evans.

Story
Seven years ago the Kingdom of Torloria was besieged by the bestial Goa Empire. Through decisive strategic planning and the sacrifice of countless heroes the Iron Guard of Torloria managed to keep the relentless hordes of Goa at bay. The Kingdom now finds respite under a thin veil of peace.


“The Roshel mines are undermanned.”


In the country’s outskirts, many of the young are summoned to the frontlines while those who remain toil in the mines, seeking a rare resource coveted by a religious order.
The sudden reappearance of monsters in the mines will spur one young miner to challenge his destiny — to confront his shameful past, seek redemption, and carve out a legacy befitting the son of the fabled 'Hero of Torloria.'
To succeed he must decipher a cryptic message that he alone can hear:


“You must protect Fate.”


His is a journey fraught with tribulation, but his companions just might be the strength he needs to overcome the trials that lie ahead.
Will they rise to the occasion, and together save Fate from the forces that lurk in the shadows?

title: Aetherlob
description:
Aetherlob is a turn-based artillery roguelite. Mara Venn has made an abandoned starwell observatory her home: Morningtide Base. Now she takes her own cannon from the rack and follows a rumor into the Starfall Corridor. Somewhere on its fifth layer, they say, a star never goes out.
The base's starwell connects you to the travelers out in the corridor. Each turn, you decide where they stand, where they aim and when to release a charged shot.
A shot through the corridorWatch the wind and the ground ahead. A high arc can reach a creature behind cover; a blast under its feet can leave it without a place to stand. The charge bar falls again after reaching its peak, so the moment you release matters as much as the angle you choose.
The corridor has its own rules. Some routes lighten gravity; others reverse the wind from round to round. A shot that worked in the last battle may need a different approach here.Beyond the next gateEach companion at a gate is tied to a route into the next layer. In a solo expedition, who you recruit determines where you go next, and your party can grow from one traveler to five. A guided shot, a heavy lob or a spread of projectiles gives the next character a different way to fight. Find weapons and relics along the way, and stop at a merchant when the party needs supplies.
The corridor has 15 themed routes across five layers. Take on elites, look for treasure, and stop to recover before facing each route's boss. The game includes 30 playable characters, 180 weapons and 650 relics. Some unlock as you play.
Command the party yourself, or share the journey through Steam online or LAN co-op. Watch how your teammates' shots reshape the terrain and use it to plan your next turn.

title: Backrooms: The Undying

The deeper you go, the more reality begins to fall apart. Something is waiting in the darkness, and it knows you are here.Venture through abandoned environments alone or with friends, survive deadly encounters, and discover the truth behind the presence that lurks somewhere within the endless maze.FeaturesAtmospheric and immersive horrorCo-opIntelligent and reactive enemy AIMultiple difficulty settingsStealth-based survival gameplayLarge interconnected levels filled with secrets and dangerUnpredictable encounters that keep the tension highDynamic visibility influenced by movement, posture, shadows, and flashlight usageImportant NotesThis game is an original interpretation inspired by the Backrooms concept and does not strictly follow established community lore. It focuses on psychological horror, environmental storytelling, and adaptive enemy behavior to create a tense and unpredictable experience.The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud sounds, darkness effects, and intense audiovisual sequences that may affect sensitive players.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
description:
Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes DEMO is available here
Beneath the city's gleaming façade, the clashing vampire factions have carved Berlin into a chessboard of blood and influence. The balance of power needs to be disrupted if the old order enforced by the Ivory Tower is to prevail.  And you are the disruption.

Sent by her Camarilla masters, Alice must navigate the intricacies of the politics at play to destabilise the region and sow discord, ensuring no one faction claims ultimate dominion.

As she sinks her teeth deeper into the city, she encounters Lenz, who is scraping by on the fringes of the undead society. Their destinies intertwine, forcing a precarious alliance. Now, they must choose: cooperate or betray one another to survive the perilous nights ahead.



Alice's efforts to destabilize the city's factions are directly reflected on a living map of Berlin. This landscape is a shifting web of contested territories, where each political maneuver brings a district closer to or further from her grasp. To achieve the task set by her masters, she must strategically influence and command the mortals and Kindred she encounters, utilizing Disciplines, the supernatural gifts of the undead.

Meanwhile, Lenz survives by other means. Lacking Alice's superior Disciplines, he turns to his Alchemical knowledge to level the playing field. He crafts varied formulae through a hands-on Alchemy System that grant him new abilities and open conversation paths that would otherwise be closed to a Thinblood.

Every conversation is a battleground. Dialogue unfolds through a branching system of choices that shape relationships, reveal secrets, and open doors or slam them shut permanently. Alice's Disciplines and Lenz's Alchemical arsenal can be brought to bear at key moments, unlocking options unavailable to the unprepared and tilting the odds in your favour.



Berlin's vampire society is vast, fractured and treacherous. From the antagonistic Anarch gangs on the surface to the remnants of old, proud Camarilla, the city's Kindred each pursue their own agendas with ruthless conviction.

In the midst of it all, Alice must navigate through uneasy alliances and cutthroat politics. As a Ventrue of cold composure, calculating intelligence, and utter ruthlessness beneath a civil veneer, she has been sent to Berlin with a single, overriding mission: to ensure the city's underworld remains fractured, and that no one rises to claim it whole. Driven solely by her ambition, she acknowledges no possibility of failure.

A Thinblood punk from Berlin's divided streets, Lenz survives on the margins, oblivious to any grand schemes. His existence is a haze of drug-laced blood, punctuated by the strange, smoldering visions that Ashe unlocks in him... visions of those who came before and whispers from vampires long reduced to ash speaking only to him. Whether that makes him cursed or gifted, he hasn't decided. Most days, survival feels like enough of an ambition.

When their worlds collide, neither emerges unchanged. Bound together by circumstances neither chose, Alice and Lenz must decide whether the other is an ally worth trusting, or a liability worth betraying.


A deep Visual Novel steeped in the rich lore of Vampire: The Masquerade. Featuring branching storylines and gameplay mechanics inspired by the 5th edition tabletop RPG, this game is designed to be effortlessly accessible for newcomers while offering depth that long-time fans will appreciate.

Play as both Alice and Lenz, two contrasting characters. Each possesses unique mechanics, motivations, and goals.
As Alice, you will utilize Disciplines - supernatural abilities that subtly sway or forcibly dominate others to fulfill your ambitions.
Take advantage of Lenz’s Alchemical prowess and brew potions to unlock new dialogue options and shape conversations your way.
Take control over the ever-shifting political map of Berlin by carefully manipulating the five warring factions.
Manage your Hunger by satisfying the ever-present bloodthirst, but be careful to maintain The Masquerade and keep the mortals unaware of your existence.
Immerse yourself in Berlin's grimy underbelly, where junkie-riddled gang hideouts contrast sharply with grandiose opera houses and glistening hotel penthouses.

Step into the shadows of the vast World of Darkness, a universe spanning decades of tabletop legend, novels, and games. Immerse yourself in the rich, sprawling mythology of vampire clans, ancient conspiracies, and the Masquerade that has been keeping humanity blind for centuries.

Whether you’re a veteran of the setting or just starting to unveil this world, the dark secrets and wonders of “Vampire: The Masquerade” will mercilessly pull you in.

title: Void Reaver
description:
Inventory management meets Bullet Heaven. You have crash-landed on a dying alien world. To survive, you must not only dodge swarms of enemies but also master the art of logistics. In this sci-fi roguelite, your backpack is your build.
Explore a colossal tower, collect experimental gear, and rearrange your inventory to trigger game-breaking synergies. Will you be the one to conquer the Void?
YOUR INVENTORY IS YOUR WEAPON

Forget simple equipment slots. Here, placement is power.

Strategize: Arrange weapons and artifacts in your backpack grid to activate powerful adjacency bonuses.
Synergize: Place elemental weapons next to melee blades for hybrid damage, or link engineering items to drones for epic buffs.
Evolve: Merge duplicate items to increase their rarity and unlock devastating new properties.

SURVIVE THE ONSLAUGHT

The combat is fast, fluid, and brutal. Your weapons fire automatically, leaving you free to focus on what matters: Movement and Survival.

Dodge & Destroy: Weave through thousands of enemies while your optimized build unleashes chaos.
Elite Challenges: Face multi-phase bosses and elite enemies that will test your reflexes and your build's efficiency.
Dynamic Arenas: Adapt to environmental hazards and biome-specific threats in hand-tailored arenas designed for infinite replayability.

ASSEMBLE YOUR CREW & EVOLVE

Death is just the beginning. The roguelite progression ensures you come back stronger after every defeat.

Deep Meta-Progression: Use resources gathered in the Void to upgrade your ship’s tech tree and unlock permanent bonuses for all characters.
Unique Specialists: Choose from a growing roster of survivors—from melee berserkers to drone engineers. Each character features their own massive skill tree and playstyle.
Limitless Combinations: With 100 weapons, 200 artifacts, and 15 unique characters, there are over 10 quintillion possible builds to discover.

KEY FEATURES
Tactical Inventory System: A puzzle within the battle. Rearrange items to trigger synergies, set bonuses, and merge duplicates for exponential power gains.
Fast-Paced Auto-Combat: A pure "Survivor-like" experience where your skill lies in positioning and dodging while your build handles the firepower.
Insane Build Variety: Experiment with Elemental, Engineering, and Melee archetypes across a roster of distinct characters.
Persistent Progression: Unlock permanent upgrades via a shared Ship Tech Tree and individual Character Skill Trees.
Epic Boss Fights: Optimize your inventory to destroy massive bosses with evolving attack patterns and mechanics.
Masterfully crafted soundtrack: A high-octane original score by acclaimed electronic music artist Nibana, featuring the reveal of his brand new music project and collaborations with Psychedelic Trance legends like Ajja and Lunarave.

title: Heart Abyss
description:
You are a half-human, half-fox, the legendary Jinko, whose ancestors once saved the human Empire from an invasion of Yokai demons. Your name is Leon, and all you remember are the walls of the cage you were imprisoned in by humans.

But now, the collar is destroyed.



The Heart Abyss combat system is sharp and bloodthirsty, just like its main character. He needs to be in the thick of battle at all times to rip health from enemies and replenish energy for magical abilities. The KEY is not to stand still!


Thanks to his heritage, Leon possesses an impressive reserve of Qi energy. Rain lightning down on your enemies' heads, shoot them with deadly energy, and... who said foxes can't create a small singularity?



Visit various corners of the Empire – from the majestic Capital to the Temple of Death, lost amidst snowy mountains. Meet interesting people and mythical creatures from Japanese folklore. Tear them to shreds (if they are warriors of the Empire).

With Leon, immerse yourself in the aesthetics of Japanese folklore, ancient temples, and Yokai demons. Here, bloody katana battles coexist with delicious ramen, torii gates, and blooming sakura.


A hundred years have passed since the invasion of the Yokai demons. The Human Empire oppresses all other magical beings, and the legendary Jinko have not been seen for many years.
Leon must uncover the reason for his people's disappearance and, perhaps, save the Empire once again. Or, conversely, plunge it into the abyss of chaos.

title: Absorber Hero RPG
description: Absorber Hero RPG is an incremental fantasy RPG with automatic combat, monster transformations and progression across repeated runs. Defeat enemies, absorb their stats, and build a hero who can take on increasingly powerful bosses.Shape each runYour Energy is limited. Choose where to travel, which enemies to fight, and which stats to absorb. Battles play out automatically, while your equipment, transformation and relic choices determine how your hero fights.Become the monsters you defeatUnlock monster transformations and master them for special combat bonuses. Combine their abilities with boss relics and equipment to build around critical hits, damage over time, defense or recovery.Find the world’s secretsExplore a connected world of ordinary encounters, bosses and optional hidden areas. Follow clues in monster lore and item descriptions to uncover secret guardians with exclusive relics and transformation mastery effects.Turn each run into lasting progressAbsorbed stats build your strength during a run. Collected equipment, upgrades, relics, unlocked transformations and achievement bonuses remain with you between runs. Spend Souls at the Soul Forge, finish your collections, and prepare for the tougher challenges of Hardmode.

title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar (2026)
description: A state-of-the-art fantasy role-playing game of unprecedented magnitude by Lord British.Prepare yourself for a grand adventure: Ultima IV, sixteen times larger than Ultima III, is a milestone in computer gaming - one that challenges your physical and mental skills while testing the true fabric of your character.Enter Britannia, kingdom of Lord British. Journey through terrain of infinite proportions, conversing with characters on hundreds of topics. Unravel the mysteries of a superior magic system. At each turn beware of daemons, dragons and long-dead wizards haunting the most tranquil of places. Encounters with parties of mixed enemy types test your strategic abilities. Shrewd use of terrain can lead to victory against seemingly impossible odds.Survive this multi-quest fantasy, then begin the final conflict, your quest of the Avatar. The ultimate challenge - the self - awaits…
